items.title: 美國擬對主要貿易夥伴加徵新關稅 歐盟強烈反對
items.title_en: U.S. Plans New Tariffs on Major Trading Partners, EU Strongly Opposes
paras: 美國政府25日宣布，計劃對主要貿易夥伴的產品加徵新一輪關稅，理由是這些國家和地區通過補貼扶持本國產業，造成工業產能過剩，損害美國企業利益。
根據美國政府公布的方案，歐盟商品關稅稅率將從10%提高至15%。
不過，這些新關稅尚未立即生效。美國政府將留出一個月時間，供公眾和企業以書面形式提交意見。
美國貿易代表格里爾25日接受《CNBC》採訪時表示，美國此次提出的是一系列針對性關稅措施，旨在應對產能過剩問題。
這輪關稅措施源於格里爾今年3月啟動的一項調查。美國貿易代表辦公室認為，包括歐盟在內的約15個貿易夥伴，通過補貼支持本國產業，導致工業產品產量過剩，對美國企業造成不利影響。
這些新關稅將疊加在美國7月底宣布的關稅之上。當時，美國以打擊強迫勞動為由，宣布對約60個國家的產品徵收至少10%額外關稅。
美國將歐盟列入新關稅目標名單，歐盟委員會發言人25日表示，歐方堅決反對，並質疑美國此次加徵關稅的合理性。
美國認為，歐盟推動再工業化的政策、非關稅壁壘，以及通過投資銀行向特定行業提供貸款等做法，構成了將歐盟納入調查範圍的理由。
不過，根據美國貿易代表辦公室提出的方案，新關稅稅率不會超過美國此前與相關貿易夥伴達成的貿易協議所允許的水準。因此，與7月底以來已經實施的額外關稅相比，此次調整幅度相對有限。
美國最高法院今年2月判定取消部分關稅措施後，白宮試圖通過新的法律依據重新實施關稅，並希望使其在法律層面更站得住腳。
paras_en: The U.S. government announced on the 25th that it plans to impose a new round of tariffs on products from major trading partners, arguing that these countries and regions subsidize their own industries, creating excess industrial capacity that harms U.S. corporate interests.
According to the U.S. government’s proposal, the tariff rate on EU goods will rise from 10% to 15%.
However, the new tariffs will not take effect immediately. The U.S. government will allow a one‑month period for the public and businesses to submit written comments.
U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Tai told CNBC in an interview on the 25th that the measures constitute a series of targeted tariffs aimed at addressing excess capacity.

The tariff round stems from an investigation launched by Tai in March. The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative believes that about 15 trading partners, including the EU, subsidize their domestic industries, leading to overproduction of industrial goods and adverse effects on U.S. firms.

These new tariffs will be added on top of those announced at the end of July, when the United States imposed at least a 10% additional duty on products from roughly 60 countries on the grounds of combating forced labor.
The EU was placed on the new tariff target list, and an EU Commission spokesperson said on the 25th that Europe firmly opposes the move and questions the justification for the U.S. tariffs.

The United States argues that the EU’s push for re‑industrialization, non‑tariff barriers, and the provision of loans to specific sectors through investment banks constitute reasons to include the EU in the investigation.

Nevertheless, the proposal from the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative states that the new tariff rates will not exceed the levels permitted under existing trade agreements with the relevant partners, so the adjustment is relatively modest compared with the extra duties already in place since late July.

After the Supreme Court ruled in February that certain tariff measures had to be lifted, the White House is seeking to re‑impose tariffs on a new legal basis, hoping to make them more defensible under the law.

items.title: 昕力資攜手國內醫學中心 首見完成血液透析碳盤查
items.title_en: Xinli Information Partners with Domestic Medical Center to Complete Blood Dialysis Carbon Footprint Assessment
paras: 資訊軟體服務商昕力資訊(7781-TW)今(26)日指出，攜手華法國際協助台灣一家大型醫學中心完成血液透析服務碳足跡盤查，並順利通過亞瑞仕國際驗證(ARES)第三方查驗，確認符合 ISO 14067:2018 標準，成為國內醫療服務碳足跡管理實務案例，昕力資目標，長期發展成醫療永續管理服務。
昕力資訊總經理葉怡蘭說明，醫療永續的第一步，是讓醫療服務的碳排放可量化、可追蹤，並作為後續管理與改善的依據。
葉怡蘭進一步說明，此次不僅提升碳足跡盤查的效率與可追溯性，也為醫療服務建立可持續運作的數位碳管理基礎，未來目標從單一的碳足跡盤查，逐步擴展至更完整的醫療永續管理。
昕力資顧問團隊整合 GreenSwift 智慧碳管理平台，串聯資料蒐集、數據建置、排放量計算、盤查報告產製和查驗佐證文件準備等流程，協助院方建立一致、可追溯的醫療服務碳管理機制。
由於醫療服務碳足跡盤查涉及醫療耗材、設備能源使用、廢棄物處理和跨部門資料整合等多元排放來源，資料蒐集、計算及查驗要求相對嚴謹；而血液透析因長期、高頻率使用水、電、醫療耗材及廢棄物處理，被視為醫療體系中高資源醫療服務之一。
在國內尚未建立血液透析服務產品類別規則的情況下，顧問團隊依循 ISO 14067 規範及產品生命週期概念，建立涵蓋原料取得、服務階段和廢棄處理的盤查流程，率先將大型醫學中心全年臨床資料納入盤查並接受外部查證，確認資料來源、邊界設定、活動數據與計算邏輯具有一致性、可追溯性。
paras_en: Xinli Information (7781-TW) announced today that it has partnered with Huafa International to help a large Taiwanese medical center complete a carbon footprint assessment for its blood dialysis services, and successfully passed the ARES international third‑party verification, confirming compliance with ISO 14067:2018 and becoming a domestic case study for medical service carbon footprint management. Xinli aims to develop long‑term sustainable medical management services.

Xinli’s general manager, Ye Yilan, explained that the first step in medical sustainability is to quantify and trace the carbon emissions of medical services, providing a basis for subsequent management and improvement.

She further added that this effort not only improves the efficiency and traceability of carbon footprint assessments but also establishes a digital carbon management foundation for sustainable medical operations, with the future goal of expanding from a single footprint assessment to a more comprehensive medical sustainability management.

Xinli’s consulting team integrated the GreenSwift smart carbon management platform, linking data collection, data construction, emission calculation, report generation, and verification documentation preparation, to help the hospital establish a consistent, traceable carbon management mechanism for medical services.

Because medical service carbon footprint assessments involve diverse emission sources such as medical consumables, equipment energy use, waste handling, and cross‑department data integration, data collection, calculation, and verification requirements are relatively stringent; blood dialysis, which requires long‑term, high‑frequency use of water, electricity, consumables, and waste disposal, is considered one of the high‑resource medical services in the healthcare system.

In the absence of established product‑category rules for blood dialysis services in Taiwan, the consulting team followed ISO 14067 guidelines and the product life‑cycle concept to establish a footprint assessment process covering raw material acquisition, service phase, and waste disposal, and was the first to include the entire clinical data of the large medical center in the assessment and undergo external verification, confirming that data sources, boundary settings, activity data, and calculation logic are consistent and traceable.

items.title: 傳五角大廈曾想動用《國防生產法》讓黃仁勳復職 官方否認
paras: 《華盛頓郵報》週三 (25 日) 報導，美國國防部長海格塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 與五角大廈高層，曾在上週末討論援引《國防生產法》(Defense Production Act)，作為施壓輝達 (NVDA-US) 董事會、促使黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 回任執行長的手段。不過，五角大廈高階官員否認曾有相關討論或提案。
這些討論發生在黃仁勳週一 (23 日) 復職之前。
三名知情人士表示，海格塞斯與副部長費恩伯格 (Steve Feinberg) 等官員，曾研議如何以這項法律作為談判籌碼，推動董事會恢復黃仁勳職務。
他們認為，輝達對美國國家安全至關重要。消息人士因涉及敏感對話，要求匿名。
《國防生產法》於 1950 年制定，賦予美國總統廣泛的經濟干預權力，過去主要用於戰爭或國家緊急狀態期間，動員民間企業提供軍事及其他必要物資。
川普第一任政府也曾在新冠疫情期間援引這項法律，要求通用汽車生產呼吸器。
報導所描述的施壓方式，是透過調整生產優先順序，影響輝達的營運安排。
一名川普政府官員向《華郵》表示：「基本上，他們可以利用《國防生產法》，迫使輝達將更多生產轉向軍事項目。」這可能干擾公司的生產計畫，並衝擊獲利。
至於相關討論是否曾傳達給總統川普或副總統范斯 (JD Vance)，目前仍不清楚，也無法確認五角大廈最終向輝達提出了哪些要求。
另有兩名知情人士告訴《華郵》，川普與范斯逐漸認定，輝達對美國經濟具有重要影響，而黃仁勳具備穩定金融市場的獨特能力。
隨著黃仁勳相關風波拖累股市，川普親自要求范斯介入，協調他重返輝達。
然而，對於上述傳聞，一名不具名的五角大廈高階官員向《華郵》否認：「報導所描述的高層對話從未發生，部長、副部長或次長也未提出任何這類方案。」
黃仁勳已於週一恢復輝達執行長職務。目前報導涉及的是官員是否曾研議以《國防生產法》施壓，並無資訊顯示美國政府已實際援引這項法律，促成此次人事決定。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 上週五重挫 14.01%，週一因黃仁勳復職狂飆 31.48%，隨後兩日累跌 9.54%，週三收 149.30 美元，回吐週一約四成漲幅，仍較復職前高出 18.94%。

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉大盤由電子權值股帶動強勢反彈逾千點 台積電仍是多空指標
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens with Strong Rebound of Over 1,000 Points Driven by Electronic Stocks, TSMC Remains a Bullish Bearish Indicator
paras: 台北股市今(26)日早盤由跌深反彈的電子股帶頭衝鋒，同時，LEO概念股、散熱股、被動元件族群及記憶體，走強華通(2313-TW)、昇達科(3491-TW)受消息面激勵漲停，雖然台積電(2330-TW)仍顯弱勢，但大盤在早盤上漲近700點。
同時，台股25日大盤譜出長長從影線，今天早盤電子走強，有助於台股的跌深後反彈的行情，。
在國安基金的宣示並已實際進場護盤及金管會的市場實質加強版限空令之下，資深證券分析師簡伯儀指出，台股如昨日的低點36681.9點不再遭跌破，有助於大盤在此止跌，但後續要關注美國Fed的升息狀況。

台北股市今天早盤大盤指數開在38435.99點，最高39176.14點，最低38435.99點，預估今天全場成交值爲8392億元，11月26日早盤電子指數上漲2.07%，占大盤成交比重75.07%，金融股上漲2.02%，占大盤成交比重1.87%。大立光(3008-TW)及台光電(2383-TW)漲停表現佳，聯發科(2454-TW)、台達電(2368-TW)及金像電(2368-TW)等AI概念股股價也走高。
台積電早盤在平盤2150元上下振盪，，而IC載板族群以景碩(3189-TW)早盤漲勢略較、欣興(3037-TW)、南電(8046-TW)的漲停爲弱。
昨晚美劇烈震盪，道瓊指數收復逾 1,100 點失土，終場上漲 164 點，但人工智慧 (AI) 概念股持續承壓，那斯達克與標普 500 指數仍收黑。美國通膨居高不下，加上白宮對主要貿易夥伴祭出新關稅，壓抑市場風險偏好，資金轉向傳統產業與公債。
而台股指標方面，輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 3.91%；台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 1.96%作收 。
paras_en: In the morning session on the 26th, the Taipei market opened with a strong rebound led by electronic stocks that had previously fallen sharply. LEO concept stocks, heat‑sink stocks, passive component groups, and memory stocks also performed well, with Hua Tong (2313‑TW) and Shengda Technology (3491‑TW) hitting their daily limits on the back of positive news. Although TSMC (2330‑TW) still showed weakness, the market rose nearly 700 points in the early session.
Meanwhile, the Taipei market on the 25th displayed a long shadow line, and the stronger electronic stocks today helped the market rebound after the sharp decline.

Under the National Security Fund’s announcement and actual intervention to support the market, along with the Financial Supervisory Commission’s strengthened short‑selling restriction, senior securities analyst Jian Boyi noted that the Taipei market’s low of 36,681.9 points on the 25th has not been breached, which helps the market stop falling. However, attention should be paid to the U.S. Federal Reserve’s interest‑rate policy moving forward.

The Taipei market opened at 38,435.99 points, reached a high of 39,176.14 points, and closed at 38,435.99 points. The estimated total transaction value for the day is 839.2 billion NTD. On the 26th, the electronic index rose 2.07%, accounting for 75.07% of market volume, while financial stocks rose 2.02%, accounting for 1.87%. Largelight (3008‑TW) and Toptica (2383‑TW) hit daily limits, and AI concept stocks such as MediaTek (2454‑TW), Delta Electronics (2368‑TW), and Jinxiang Electronics (2368‑TW) also saw price gains.

In the morning, TSMC traded around 2,150 NTD with little movement, while the IC substrate group saw a slightly stronger early rise from Jingshuo (3189‑TW). Xinxing (3037‑TW) and Nandian (8046‑TW) hit daily limits but were weaker.

Last night, the U.S. markets were highly volatile. The Dow Jones Industrial Average recovered over 1,100 points, closing up 164 points, but AI concept stocks continued to face pressure, and both the Nasdaq and S&P 500 ended lower. U.S. inflation remained high, and the White House imposed new tariffs on major trade partners, dampening risk appetite and shifting capital toward traditional industries and government bonds.

In the morning, U.S. major indices performed as follows: the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 164.25 points (0.33%) to 50,182.95; the Nasdaq Composite fell 147.73 points (0.62%) to 23,585.80; the S&P 500 fell 18.31 points (0.25%) to 7,182.78; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 57.64 points (0.65%) to 8,774.86; and the NYSE FANG+ Index fell 122.71 points (0.76%) to 16,057.95.
Regarding Taiwanese stocks, NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) fell 3.91%, and TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) fell 1.96% at close.

items.title: AI記憶體紅利推高經濟成長！南韓央行宣布升息1碼抗通膨 與美利差降至0.75個百分點
items.title_en: AI Memory Bonus Fuels Economic Growth! South Korea Central Bank Raises Interest Rate by 1 Basis Point to Combat Inflation, US-Korea Spread Drops to 0.75 Percentage Point
paras: 南韓央行(BOK)週四(26日)宣布將7天期回購利率上調25個基點至3.25%，結束10月暫停節奏、恢復升息。今年7、8月連升兩次後累計緊縮幅度達75個基點，這是BOK今年下半年第三次升息，與美國的利率差距縮至0.75個百分點。
BOK同步上修經濟成長預期，今年GDP成長率估值從3.3%調高至3.9%，2027年從2.9%上調至4.1%；10月消費者物價指數(CPI)仍達2.8%，核心通膨2.8%，均高於2%目標，房價也還在漲。
驅動力來自「出口端超強、消費端偏弱」的撕裂基本面。全球AI基礎建設投資帶動HBM與企業級NAND超級週期，南韓半導體出口放量，推升經濟成長遠超預期。
BOK決策官員釋放清晰信號：在半導體榮景抵銷家庭需求疲軟、韓股綜合股指(KOSPI)波動的當下，通膨壓力與出口驅動擴張優先級壓過內需擔憂。
不過，市場並非全無顧慮。美銀指出，經常帳順差撐住韓元，但外資持續拋售韓股、綜合指數難守5000點上方；高盛則警告超額利潤集中在三星、海力士兩家，未有效外溢到居民部門，消費僅溫和復甦。
BOK總裁申鉉松隨後記者會成焦點，市場將觀察「終端利率是否衝3.5%」與2027年經濟成長預期會否再上修。若明年GDP成長率估值破3.5%，代表央行對半導體週期更樂觀、緊縮尾巴更長；若措辭轉鴿，則暗示內需與科技股財富效應萎縮已進入決策權衡。
paras_en: The Bank of Korea (BOK) announced on Thursday (26th) that it would raise the 7‑day repo rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, ending the pause in October and resuming rate hikes. After two consecutive increases in July and August, the cumulative tightening has reached 75 basis points, marking the third rate hike for BOK in the second half of the year, and narrowing the gap with U.S. rates to 0.75 percentage point.

BOK also lifted its economic growth outlook, raising the estimated GDP growth rate for this year from 3.3% to 3.9% and for 2027 from 2.9% to 4.1%. The October consumer price index (CPI) remains at 2.8%, core inflation at 2.8%, both above the 2% target, and housing prices continue to rise.

The driving force comes from a split fundamental: a strong export side versus a weaker consumption side. Global AI infrastructure investment is driving a super‑cycle for HBM and enterprise‑grade NAND, boosting South Korean semiconductor exports and pushing economic growth far beyond expectations.

BOK decision makers sent a clear signal: amid the semiconductor boom offsetting weak household demand and volatility in the KOSPI, inflationary pressure and export‑driven expansion take priority over concerns about domestic demand.

However, the market is not without concerns. Bank of America noted that the current account surplus supports the won, but foreign investors continue to sell Korean stocks, making it difficult for the KOSPI to stay above 5,000 points. Goldman Sachs warned that excess profits are concentrated in Samsung and SK Hynix, not effectively spilling over to the consumer sector, and consumption is only mildly recovering.

BOK Governor Seon Hyeon‑song became the focus of a subsequent press conference, with the market watching whether the “terminal rate will hit 3.5%” and whether the 2027 growth outlook will be revised upward. If next year’s GDP growth estimate exceeds 3.5%, it would indicate the central bank is more optimistic about the semiconductor cycle and will keep tightening longer; a dovish tone would suggest that the contraction of domestic demand and the wealth effect of tech stocks have entered decision‑making considerations.

items.title: 黃仁勳「失業11天」在幹嘛？曾私訊好友想騎重機橫越美國
items.title_en: Jensen Huang "Unemployed for 11 Days"—What Was He Doing? He Texted a Friend About Riding a Motorcycle Across the U.S.
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 短暫離開執行長職位期間，曾想騎重機橫越美國。美國知名 Podcast 主持人弗里德曼 (Lex Fridman) 透露，黃仁勳上週主動傳訊息，表示想加入他正在進行的公路旅行。如今黃仁勳重返輝達，讓他忍不住感嘆：「真後悔當時沒有答應，現在他又要忙起來了。」
弗里德曼在社群平台 X 發文表示，自己正在騎機車橫越美國，黃仁勳得知後提出加入，兩人可以各騎一輛機車同行。
他坦言，這番話聽起來或許像在開玩笑，但黃仁勳「很可能是認真的」。
不過，這趟結伴旅行還沒成行，黃仁勳便於 23 日恢復輝達總裁、執行長及董事職務，距離請辭僅過 11 天。
弗里德曼未透露兩人是否討論過出發日期或路線，貼文中則流露出錯過邀約的惋惜。
兩人的往來也不只限於節目訪談。
弗里德曼先前曾表示，自己認識黃仁勳已久，兩人還曾在台灣一起逛夜市、品嘗小吃，談論黃仁勳的童年回憶與科技產業。
除了分享重機邀約，弗里德曼也在貼文中聲援黃仁勳，認為世界需要更多像他這樣的領導者。
他直言，許多領袖表現不佳，值得肯定的人應受到保護，並援引馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 的觀點，主張在人陷入低潮時伸出援手，而非落井下石。
弗里德曼表示，每個人都有缺點，也難免犯錯，但人性中的善意比惡意更多，社會應多支持值得肯定的人與事。
談到美中科技競爭，弗里德曼認為，中國應是美國的競爭對手，而非敵人，因為「戰爭帶來破壞，競爭帶來創造」。
他強調，身為美國人，自己希望美國勝出，但應透過良性競爭，而非軍事衝突與局勢升級。
他也提醒外界，應警惕軍工複合體透過煽動仇恨、恐懼與分裂，推升對抗情緒，並將黃仁勳形容為「和平締造者」，認為他對美國在科技競爭中取得成功至關重要。
發文當下，弗里德曼仍在旅途中。
他說，自己正坐在偏遠地區的一處加油站，喝完咖啡、稍作休息後，準備繼續騎車上路，並感嘆騎機車帶來的自由感無可比擬。至於曾想加入的黃仁勳，則已回到輝達，重新投入公司事務。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 上週五重挫 14.01%，週一因黃仁勳復職狂飆 31.48%，隨後兩日累跌 9.54%，週三收 149.30 美元，回吐週一約四成漲幅，仍較復職前高出 18.94%。
paras_en: During a brief period when NVIDIA (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang stepped away from the CEO role, he considered riding a motorcycle across the United States. U.S. podcast host Lex Fridman revealed that last week Huang proactively sent a message expressing his desire to join Fridman's ongoing road trip. Now that Huang has returned to NVIDIA, he cannot help but lament, "I really regret not agreeing back then; now he's busy again."
Fridman posted on X that he was riding a motorcycle across the U.S., and upon learning this, Huang suggested joining him, with the two of them riding separate bikes together.
He admitted that the suggestion might sound like a joke, but Huang "probably was serious."
However, the joint trip never materialized, and on the 23rd Huang resumed his positions as NVIDIA president, CEO, and board member, just 11 days after announcing his resignation.
Fridman did not disclose whether the two discussed a departure date or route; the post expressed regret at missing the invitation.
Their interactions extend beyond interview appearances.

Fridman previously noted that he has known Huang for a long time, and the two once visited night markets and sampled street food in Taiwan, discussing Huang's childhood memories and the tech industry.
In addition to sharing the motorcycle invitation, Fridman also voiced support for Huang, stating that the world needs more leaders like him.

He bluntly said that many leaders perform poorly, and those who deserve recognition should be protected, citing Elon Musk's view that one should lend a hand when people are in a slump rather than throw stones into a pit.
Fridman said everyone has flaws and can make mistakes, but the good in humanity outweighs the bad; society should support those who deserve praise and positive actions.
When discussing U.S.-China tech competition, Fridman believes China should be a competitor, not an enemy, because "war brings destruction, competition brings creation."
He emphasized that as an American, he hopes the U.S. wins, but through healthy competition rather than military conflict or escalation.

He also warned the public to be wary of the military-industrial complex inflaming hatred, fear, and division to heighten antagonism, and described Huang as a "peacemaker," believing he is crucial to U.S. success in tech competition.
At the time of posting, Fridman was still on the road.

He said he was sitting at a remote gas station, finished a cup of coffee, took a short break, and was ready to continue riding, marveling at the incomparable freedom of motorcycling; as for Huang, he had returned to NVIDIA and refocused on company matters.

NVIDIA (NVDA-US) fell 14.01% last Friday, surged 31.48% on Monday after Huang's return, then dropped 9.54% over the next two days, closing at $149.30 on Wednesday, retracting about 40% of Monday's gains but remaining 18.94% above the pre‑resignation level.

items.title: 川普12/4赴亞利桑那州 出席台積電晶片廠擴建動土典禮
items.title_en: Trump to Attend TSMC Arizona Plant Groundbreaking on Dec. 4
paras: 《美聯社》報導，白宮與台灣半導體製造商台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)表示，將經濟政策寄望於AI產業成長的美國總統川普，將於12月4日前往亞利桑那州，出席台積電新晶圓廠的動土典禮。
此次行程正值華府本週密切檢視AI產業之際。此前，川普介入輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)執行長人事，協助黃仁勳重新掌舵。黃仁勳預定12月3日出席參議院銀行委員會聽證會，屆時將面臨議員質詢，內容包括輝達如何向海外銷售晶片，以及他與一名涉嫌中國間諜的女性發生婚外情一事。
台積電近年積極擴大在亞利桑那州鳳凰城一帶的布局，並利用美國廠區為輝達、蘋果(AAPL-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)及高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)等科技公司生產晶片。川普此次將出席台積電亞利桑那州擴建計畫第五期工程的動土典禮。
台積電今年7月宣布，將再投入1,000億美元擴大美國製造產能，使其在美國晶片製造領域承諾的總投資額達到2,650億美元。
隨著人工智慧發展帶動電腦晶片需求增加，加上台灣在晶片製造領域的主導地位，促使包括美國在內的各國正透過提高國內產能，因應供應鏈脆弱性的問題，台積電的投資規模也隨之擴大。
川普一直試圖將這些投資歸功於他的關稅政策，但台積電早在前總統拜登任內，就已開始在亞利桑那州興建廠房。拜登簽署生效的跨黨派「晶片與科學法案」(CHIPS and Science Act)，也為這項計畫提供部分財務支持。
白宮表示，這次擴建計畫預計將創造1萬個直接就業機會，以及在周邊社區新增1.1萬個間接就業機會。目前該廠區已提供超過1.2萬個營建工作機會。
paras_en: The Associated Press reports that the White House and Taiwan semiconductor manufacturer TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) say that U.S. President Donald Trump, who has placed economic policy hopes on the growth of the AI industry, will travel to Arizona on December 4 to attend the groundbreaking ceremony for TSMC’s new wafer plant.

This trip comes as Washington closely examines the AI sector this week. Earlier, Trump intervened in Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO personnel, helping Jensen Huang regain control. Huang is scheduled to appear before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3, where he will face questions from senators about Nvidia’s overseas chip sales and a rumored affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.

TSMC has been actively expanding its footprint around Phoenix, Arizona, and uses its U.S. facilities to produce chips for Nvidia, Apple (AAPL‑US), AMD (AMD‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US). Trump will attend the groundbreaking for Phase 5 of TSMC’s Arizona expansion plan.
In July, TSMC announced it would invest an additional $100 billion to expand U.S. manufacturing capacity, bringing its total U.S. investment pledge to $265 billion.

With AI development driving increased demand for computer chips and Taiwan’s dominance in chip manufacturing, countries including the United States are boosting domestic capacity to address supply‑chain fragility, leading to larger TSMC investment scales.

Trump has long tried to attribute these investments to his tariff policy, but TSMC began building its Arizona plant during former President Biden’s term. Biden signed the bipartisan CHIPS and Science Act, which also provided partial financial support for the project.
The White House says the expansion is expected to create 10,000 direct jobs and add 11,000 indirect jobs in surrounding communities. The site already offers more than 12,000 construction jobs.

items.title: AI信仰遭遇極限壓力測試！美股超級「V轉」 分析師：深V不是轉折  是分歧
items.title_en: AI Faith Faces Extreme Pressure Test! US Stocks Super “V-Shape” Analysts: Deep V Is Not a Turning Point but a Divergence
paras: 華爾街週三(25日)上演一場「驚魂深V」劇本，盤中恐慌式殺盤，尾盤硬拉收回，但市場情緒的底層邏輯已經換了。
那斯達克100指數(NDX) 開盤5分鐘便重挫近5%，那斯達克指數一度跌約4.5%，標普500盤中跌超3%、道瓊指數(DJI) 一度狂瀉逾1100點，費城半導體(SOX)跌近8%，輝達(NVDA-US) 盤中一度跌近9%，隨後跌幅全數收斂，道瓊翻紅收漲0.33%，標普僅跌0.25%，那指收跌0.62%。
金銀同步演「超級V」，現貨金價盤中最低見到每盎司3426美元，尾盤拉回漲0.92%收3588.41美元，白銀盤中跌超6%，收漲1.15%至41.38美元。
兩天前白宮推動黃仁勳復任輝達執行長，曾讓AI鏈單日暴漲、那指漲超6%，但這波「情緒紓困」沒撐過一日遊。
Running Oak Capital執行長Seth Cogswell直言：「這試圖成為一次AI行業紓困，但沒奏效，人們看穿了。」
更麻煩的是治理溢價被撕開。標普全球評級週三將輝達AA評級列入「負面觀察」，指黃仁勳離任又復職暴露董事會獨立性、接班計畫與監督機制漏洞，90天內可能降至AA-，輝達週三收跌3.91%，CDS違約保護成本創新高。
真正壓抑風險偏好的，是敘事切換。Solstein Capital執行長Terman說：「市場不再爭論AI會不會改變世界，而在問誰能賺錢、能賺多少、數兆美元資本開支能不能回收。諷刺的是，技術承諾兌現了，財務回報卻可能讓投資人失望。」
聯準會(Fed)重啟緊縮讓這道題更尖銳：融資成本抬升，資料中心、HBM、算力租賃的ROI必須更高才合理。期中選舉後民主黨對資料中心擴張的阻力、出口管制不確定性，再疊一層政策折現風險。
NYSE交易廳老將Jonathan Corpina把當前市場情緒跟2008年時類比說道：「不是拋售規模一樣，是那種『接下來還會怎樣』的持續不安。」
TradeMas交易員Peter Tuchman則說：「從未見過同一個故事——英偉達——讓市場看法反轉得這麼徹底。」
分析師指出，拋售「有序」，獲利與宏觀底子還在，但盤面已變成情緒博弈。
Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek苦笑說：「過去10天搖頭次數太多，脖子都酸了。」他客戶最怕的不是繼續跌，而是「萬一反彈踏空」。
深V不是轉折，是分歧。AI技術前景不再是最大爭議，「數兆美元投入能否變成足夠獲利、市場還願不願續費」才是定價核心。短期看Fed態度與輝達治理修補，中期看雲廠資本開支回報，這一輪洗盤後，留下的只會是最有信念、也最會算帳的資金。
paras_en: Wall Street staged a “deep V” drama on Wednesday (25th), with panic selling in the middle of the day and a hard pullback at the close, but the underlying market logic had already shifted.

The Nasdaq 100 (NDX) fell nearly 5% in the first five minutes of trading, the Nasdaq index briefly dropped about 4.5%, the S&P 500 fell over 3% mid‑day, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJI) plunged more than 1,100 points, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) fell nearly 8%, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped almost 9% mid‑day before the declines converged; the Dow ended up 0.33% higher, the S&P only down 0.25%, and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.

Gold and silver both performed a “super V,” with spot gold hitting a low of $3,426 per ounce mid‑day and rebounding 0.92% to close at $3,588.41, while silver fell over 6% mid‑day and closed up 1.15% at $41.38.

Two days ago the White House pushed for Jensen Huang’s reappointment as Nvidia CEO, which once caused a one‑day surge in AI stocks and a 6% rise in the Nasdaq, but this “emotional relief” did not last beyond the day.
Running Oak Capital CEO Seth Cogswell bluntly said, “This was an attempt to provide a bailout for the AI industry, but it failed; people see through it.”

Complicating matters further, governance premiums were ripped apart. S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia’s AA rating under “negative watch” on Wednesday, citing that Huang’s departure and return exposed board independence, succession planning, and oversight mechanism weaknesses, with a possible downgrade to AA‑ within 90 days. Nvidia fell 3.91% on Wednesday and CDS default protection costs hit a new high.

The real risk‑aversion comes from a narrative shift. Solstein Capital CEO Terman said, “The market no longer debates whether AI will change the world; it asks who can make money, how much, and whether the trillions of dollars in capital spend can be recouped. Ironically, the technology promise has been fulfilled, but financial returns may disappoint investors.”

The Fed’s re‑tightening makes this issue sharper: financing costs rise, and the ROI for data centers, HBM, and compute‑as‑a‑service must be higher to be justified. After the midterm election, Democratic resistance to data‑center expansion, export‑control uncertainty, and additional policy discount risk stack on.
NYSE veteran Jonathan Corpina compared the current market sentiment to 2008, saying, “It’s not the same scale of selling, but the persistent unease about ‘what will happen next’.”
TradeMas trader Peter Tuchman said, “I’ve never seen the same story—Nvidia—flip market sentiment so thoroughly.”
Analysts noted that the sell‑off is “ordered,” profits and macro fundamentals remain, but the market has become an emotional game.

Siebert Financial CIO Mark Malek grimaced, “We’ve been shaking our heads too many times in the past 10 days; our necks are sore.” He said his clients fear not a continued decline but a missed rebound if they sell too early.

The deep V is not a turning point but a divergence. The future of AI technology is no longer the biggest debate; the question is whether trillions of dollars of investment can generate sufficient profit and whether the market will continue to pay for it. In the short term, Fed stance and Nvidia governance fixes matter; in the midterm, cloud‑provider capital‑spend returns will determine the outcome. After this round of market cleaning, only the most committed and financially savvy investors will remain.

items.title: 昕力資攜手國內醫學中心 首見完成血液透析碳盤查
items.title_en: Xinli Information Partners with Domestic Medical Center to Complete Blood Dialysis Carbon Footprint Assessment
paras: 資訊軟體服務商昕力資訊(7781-TW)今(26)日指出，攜手華法國際協助台灣一家大型醫學中心完成血液透析服務碳足跡盤查，並順利通過亞瑞仕國際驗證(ARES)第三方查驗，確認符合 ISO 14067:2018 標準，成為國內醫療服務碳足跡管理實務案例，昕力資目標，長期發展成醫療永續管理服務。
昕力資訊總經理葉怡蘭說明，醫療永續的第一步，是讓醫療服務的碳排放可量化、可追蹤，並作為後續管理與改善的依據。
葉怡蘭進一步說明，此次不僅提升碳足跡盤查的效率與可追溯性，也為醫療服務建立可持續運作的數位碳管理基礎，未來目標從單一的碳足跡盤查，逐步擴展至更完整的醫療永續管理。
昕力資顧問團隊整合 GreenSwift 智慧碳管理平台，串聯資料蒐集、數據建置、排放量計算、盤查報告產製和查驗佐證文件準備等流程，協助院方建立一致、可追溯的醫療服務碳管理機制。
由於醫療服務碳足跡盤查涉及醫療耗材、設備能源使用、廢棄物處理和跨部門資料整合等多元排放來源，資料蒐集、計算及查驗要求相對嚴謹；而血液透析因長期、高頻率使用水、電、醫療耗材及廢棄物處理，被視為醫療體系中高資源醫療服務之一。
在國內尚未建立血液透析服務產品類別規則的情況下，顧問團隊依循 ISO 14067 規範及產品生命週期概念，建立涵蓋原料取得、服務階段和廢棄處理的盤查流程，率先將大型醫學中心全年臨床資料納入盤查並接受外部查證，確認資料來源、邊界設定、活動數據與計算邏輯具有一致性、可追溯性。
paras_en: Xinli Information (7781-TW) announced today that it has partnered with Huafa International to help a large Taiwanese medical center complete a carbon footprint assessment for its blood dialysis services, and successfully passed the ARES international third‑party verification, confirming compliance with ISO 14067:2018 and becoming a domestic case study for medical service carbon footprint management. Xinli aims to develop long‑term sustainable medical management services.

Xinli’s general manager, Ye Yilan, explained that the first step in medical sustainability is to quantify and trace the carbon emissions of medical services, providing a basis for subsequent management and improvement.

She further added that this effort not only improves the efficiency and traceability of carbon footprint assessments but also establishes a digital carbon management foundation for sustainable medical operations, with the future goal of expanding from a single footprint assessment to a more comprehensive medical sustainability management.

Xinli’s consulting team integrated the GreenSwift smart carbon management platform, linking data collection, data construction, emission calculation, report generation, and verification documentation preparation, to help the hospital establish a consistent, traceable carbon management mechanism for medical services.

Because medical service carbon footprint assessments involve diverse emission sources such as medical consumables, equipment energy use, waste handling, and cross‑department data integration, data collection, calculation, and verification requirements are relatively stringent; blood dialysis, which requires long‑term, high‑frequency use of water, electricity, consumables, and waste disposal, is considered one of the high‑resource medical services in the healthcare system.

In the absence of established product‑category rules for blood dialysis services in Taiwan, the consulting team followed ISO 14067 guidelines and the product life‑cycle concept to establish a footprint assessment process covering raw material acquisition, service phase, and waste disposal, and was the first to include the entire clinical data of the large medical center in the assessment and undergo external verification, confirming that data sources, boundary settings, activity data, and calculation logic are consistent and traceable.

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉大盤由電子權值股帶動強勢反彈逾千點 台積電仍是多空指標
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens with Strong Rebound of Over 1,000 Points Driven by Electronic Stocks, TSMC Remains a Bullish Bearish Indicator
paras: 台北股市今(26)日早盤由跌深反彈的電子股帶頭衝鋒，同時，LEO概念股、散熱股、被動元件族群及記憶體，走強華通(2313-TW)、昇達科(3491-TW)受消息面激勵漲停，雖然台積電(2330-TW)仍顯弱勢，但大盤在早盤上漲近700點。
同時，台股25日大盤譜出長長從影線，今天早盤電子走強，有助於台股的跌深後反彈的行情，。
在國安基金的宣示並已實際進場護盤及金管會的市場實質加強版限空令之下，資深證券分析師簡伯儀指出，台股如昨日的低點36681.9點不再遭跌破，有助於大盤在此止跌，但後續要關注美國Fed的升息狀況。

台北股市今天早盤大盤指數開在38435.99點，最高39176.14點，最低38435.99點，預估今天全場成交值爲8392億元，11月26日早盤電子指數上漲2.07%，占大盤成交比重75.07%，金融股上漲2.02%，占大盤成交比重1.87%。大立光(3008-TW)及台光電(2383-TW)漲停表現佳，聯發科(2454-TW)、台達電(2368-TW)及金像電(2368-TW)等AI概念股股價也走高。
台積電早盤在平盤2150元上下振盪，，而IC載板族群以景碩(3189-TW)早盤漲勢略較、欣興(3037-TW)、南電(8046-TW)的漲停爲弱。
昨晚美劇烈震盪，道瓊指數收復逾 1,100 點失土，終場上漲 164 點，但人工智慧 (AI) 概念股持續承壓，那斯達克與標普 500 指數仍收黑。美國通膨居高不下，加上白宮對主要貿易夥伴祭出新關稅，壓抑市場風險偏好，資金轉向傳統產業與公債。
而台股指標方面，輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 3.91%；台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 1.96%作收 。
paras_en: In the morning session on the 26th, the Taipei market opened with a strong rebound led by electronic stocks that had previously fallen sharply. LEO concept stocks, heat‑sink stocks, passive component groups, and memory stocks also performed well, with Hua Tong (2313‑TW) and Shengda Technology (3491‑TW) hitting their daily limits on the back of positive news. Although TSMC (2330‑TW) still showed weakness, the market rose nearly 700 points in the early session.
Meanwhile, the Taipei market on the 25th displayed a long shadow line, and the stronger electronic stocks today helped the market rebound after the sharp decline.

Under the National Security Fund’s announcement and actual intervention to support the market, along with the Financial Supervisory Commission’s strengthened short‑selling restriction, senior securities analyst Jian Boyi noted that the Taipei market’s low of 36,681.9 points on the 25th has not been breached, which helps the market stop falling. However, attention should be paid to the U.S. Federal Reserve’s interest‑rate policy moving forward.

items.title_en: Trump to Attend TSMC Arizona Plant Groundbreaking on Dec. 4
paras: 《美聯社》報導，白宮與台灣半導體製造商台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)表示，將經濟政策寄望於AI產業成長的美國總統川普，將於12月4日前往亞利桑那州，出席台積電新晶圓廠的動土典禮。
此次行程正值華府本週密切檢視AI產業之際。此前，川普介入輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)執行長人事，協助黃仁勳重新掌舵。黃仁勳預定12月3日出席參議院銀行委員會聽證會，屆時將面臨議員質詢，內容包括輝達如何向海外銷售晶片，以及他與一名涉嫌中國間諜的女性發生婚外情一事。
台積電近年積極擴大在亞利桑那州鳳凰城一帶的布局，並利用美國廠區為輝達、蘋果(AAPL-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)及高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)等科技公司生產晶片。川普此次將出席台積電亞利桑那州擴建計畫第五期工程的動土典禮。
台積電今年7月宣布，將再投入1,000億美元擴大美國製造產能，使其在美國晶片製造領域承諾的總投資額達到2,650億美元。
隨著人工智慧發展帶動電腦晶片需求增加，加上台灣在晶片製造領域的主導地位，促使包括美國在內的各國正透過提高國內產能，因應供應鏈脆弱性的問題，台積電的投資規模也隨之擴大。
川普一直試圖將這些投資歸功於他的關稅政策，但台積電早在前總統拜登任內，就已開始在亞利桑那州興建廠房。拜登簽署生效的跨黨派「晶片與科學法案」(CHIPS and Science Act)，也為這項計畫提供部分財務支持。
白宮表示，這次擴建計畫預計將創造1萬個直接就業機會，以及在周邊社區新增1.1萬個間接就業機會。目前該廠區已提供超過1.2萬個營建工作機會。
paras_en: The Associated Press reports that the White House and Taiwan semiconductor manufacturer TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) say that U.S. President Donald Trump, who has placed economic policy hopes on the growth of the AI industry, will travel to Arizona on December 4 to attend the groundbreaking ceremony for TSMC’s new wafer plant.

This trip comes as Washington closely examines the AI sector this week. Earlier, Trump intervened in Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO personnel, helping Jensen Huang regain control. Huang is scheduled to appear before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3, where he will face questions from senators about Nvidia’s overseas chip sales and a rumored affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.

TSMC has been actively expanding its footprint around Phoenix, Arizona, and uses its U.S. facilities to produce chips for Nvidia, Apple (AAPL‑US), AMD (AMD‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US). Trump will attend the groundbreaking for Phase 5 of TSMC’s Arizona expansion plan.
In July, TSMC announced it would invest an additional $100 billion to expand U.S. manufacturing capacity, bringing its total U.S. investment pledge to $265 billion.

With AI development driving increased demand for computer chips and Taiwan’s dominance in chip manufacturing, countries including the United States are boosting domestic capacity to address supply‑chain fragility, leading to larger TSMC investment scales.

Trump has long tried to attribute these investments to his tariff policy, but TSMC began building its Arizona plant during former President Biden’s term. Biden signed the bipartisan CHIPS and Science Act, which also provided partial financial support for the project.
The White House says the expansion is expected to create 10,000 direct jobs and add 11,000 indirect jobs in surrounding communities. The site already offers more than 12,000 construction jobs.

items.title_en: ESG Craze: Jiantian Technology Earns TCSA Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Award for 11th Consecutive Year and Receives Two Honors
paras: 台灣永續能源研究基金會(TAISE)主辦的「2026第十九屆TCSA台灣企業永續獎」於25日在圓山大飯店舉行頒獎典禮。全球PCB精密微型鑽針領導廠商尖點科技(8021-TW)，憑藉在環境保護（E）、社會責任（S）及公司治理（G）三大面向的長期投入與持續精進，連續11年獲TCSA肯定。
尖點科技在「2026第十九屆TCSA台灣企業永續獎」獲「永續綜合績效－台灣永續績優企業」及「永續報告書－白金級」雙項殊榮，更為本屆PCB／PCBA產業第二類組（營收未達新台幣150億元）唯一獲得永續報告書白金級之企業。頒獎典禮由尖點科技總經理林若萍代表出席領獎。
本屆TCSA共吸引773家企業與組織參與評選，主辦單位在今年首度依企業營收規模調整評選分組，以更具可比性的評選基準，衡量企業永續治理與實踐成果。尖點科技不僅獲得「台灣永續績優企業」肯定，永續報告書亦由去年的金級晉升至最高等級「白金級」，充分展現公司在永續治理、資訊揭露及管理機制上的持續精進。
尖點科技自2016年起連續11年參與TCSA評選，年年均獲獎項肯定，歷年來曾多次榮獲永續報告書白金級與金級殊榮。公司長期將永續理念融入經營策略與日常營運管理，透過集團各營運據點及子公司的共同投入，持續推動節能減碳、資源有效利用、責任供應鏈及職場安全等重點工作，逐步深化集團永續治理，強化企業長期競爭力與營運韌性。
尖點科技總經理兼永續長林若萍表示，永續經營是企業長期發展的重要基礎，獎項的肯定不僅是對公司過往努力的認可，更是持續精進的動力。隨著全球營運規模擴大及產業技術持續升級，尖點將在追求營運成長與技術創新的同時，持續深化永續治理、碳管理及資源使用效率，並攜手上下游合作夥伴，共同提升產業永續競爭力，為客戶、員工、股東及其他利害關係人創造長期價值。
paras_en: The 19th TCSA Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Award, hosted by the Taiwan Sustainable Energy Research Foundation (TAISE), was presented on the 25th at the Yuan-Shan Grand Hotel. Global leader in precision micro PCB pin drills, Jiantian Technology (8021‑TW), has been recognized by TCSA for 11 consecutive years for its long‑term investment and continuous improvement in environmental protection (E), social responsibility (S), and corporate governance (G).

In the 19th TCSA award, Jiantian Technology received the “Sustainability Comprehensive Performance – Taiwan Outstanding Sustainability Enterprise” and the “Sustainability Report – Platinum Level” honors, becoming the only company in the PCB/PCBA Industry Category 2 (revenue below NT$15 billion) to achieve Platinum status for its sustainability report. The award ceremony was attended by Jiantian’s General Manager, Lin Ruo‑ping, who accepted the awards on behalf of the company.

This year’s TCSA attracted 773 companies and organizations. For the first time, the organizers adjusted the evaluation groups based on revenue size to provide more comparable criteria for assessing sustainability governance and practice. Jiantian not only earned the “Taiwan Outstanding Sustainability Enterprise” title but also upgraded its sustainability report from last year’s Gold level to the highest Platinum level, demonstrating continuous progress in governance, disclosure, and management mechanisms.

Since 2016, Jiantian has participated in TCSA evaluations for 11 consecutive years, consistently receiving awards. The company has repeatedly earned Gold and Platinum sustainability report honors. By embedding sustainability into its business strategy and daily operations, and through joint efforts across its group sites and subsidiaries, Jiantian continuously promotes energy saving, carbon reduction, efficient resource use, responsible supply chains, and workplace safety, gradually deepening group sustainability governance and strengthening long‑term competitiveness and operational resilience.

General Manager and Sustainability Officer Lin Ruo‑ping stated that sustainable operations are the foundation for long‑term corporate development. The award not only recognizes past efforts but also motivates further improvement. As global operations expand and industry technology advances, Jiantian will pursue growth and innovation while deepening sustainability governance, carbon management, and resource efficiency, partnering with upstream and downstream collaborators to enhance industry sustainability competitiveness and create long‑term value for customers, employees, shareholders, and other stakeholders.
