items.title: 美銀2027年展望：AI投資成美國經濟最大變數 Fed料再升息三次
paras: 美銀全球研究11月24日發布「2027年美國經濟展望」報告指出，在企業投資和居民消費支撐下，美國實質GDP預計將在2027年和2028年分別成長2.3%和2.1%，但通膨仍將高於聯準會(Fed)目標。該行預計，聯準會將在接下來三次會議上各升息25個基點，而AI資本支出週期是上述預測面臨的最大不確定性。
美銀認為，AI產業的規模經濟特徵容易導致「理性過度投資」。這個領域最終可能只有少數企業勝出，但每家企業都不得不按照自己將成為贏家的假設進行投資。即使個別企業的投資決策具有合理性，整個產業仍可能出現過度投資。目前最關鍵的問題是，這波資本支出週期何時出現轉折。
據美銀測算，自2025年第一季以來，美國軟體、資料中心、電腦及周邊設備等AI相關資本支出項目的實質年化增速約為26%。
這項高增速存在兩種截然不同的解讀：一是AI投資浪潮的整體規模超出先前預期；二是大量投資被提前執行，意味著未來資本支出可能更早出現大幅下滑，且下滑程度更為劇烈。美銀認為，近期經濟數據尚不足以判斷哪種情況更接近現實。
在基準情境下，美銀預計企業投資至少在2027年上半年保持強勁，隨後逐步放緩。美國實質非住宅投資增速預計將從2026年的7.6%降至2027年的7.0%，並在2028年進一步降至2.9%。按季增率折年率計算，非住宅投資增速預計將從2027年第一季的6.3%降至第四季的2.9%，並在2028年各季維持在2.3%。該行並未在基準預測中納入投資萎縮的情境，主要是因為難以判斷其發生時間。
美銀認為，美國期中選舉結果不會顯著改變其資本支出展望。即使部分州政府出台措施放緩資料中心建設，新規也需要時間才能影響經濟活動，而避免投資過度提前，反而可能降低未來的經濟衰退風險。
美銀還指出，由於企業發布投資指引與相關變化反映在GDP數據中存在時間差，金融市場可能在資本支出實際大幅下滑之前就提前反映，但期間也可能多次發出錯誤訊號。如何區分真正的週期轉折與市場雜訊，將是經濟學家和投資人面臨的一大挑戰。

居民消費仍具韌性 高低收入群體消費增速差距逆轉

除企業投資外，居民消費仍是美國經濟成長的另一大支柱。美銀預計，2027年和2028年美國實質居民消費將分別成長2.3%和2.2%。
儘管今年美國經濟遭遇能源價格衝擊，但財政刺激、AI繁榮帶來的股票財富效應以及就業成長改善，使居民消費展現顯著韌性。
值得注意的是，美國銀行內部信用卡和簽帳金融卡數據顯示，最近數週，低收入家庭扣除汽油支出後的戶均銀行卡消費年增率持續超過高收入家庭，此前高收入家庭消費增速領先的局面，在該行樣本數據中出現逆轉。
展望2027年，美銀認為，能源價格持平或下降帶來的整體通膨回落，將成為實質消費成長最重要的有利因素。美國社會安全福利的生活成本調整幅度，也將從今年1月的2.8%升至明年1月的3.6%。
與此同時，隨著《大而美法案》中的醫療補助計畫削減措施逐步加大力道，以及關稅退款效應消退，財政政策對經濟成長的邊際影響將轉為輕微負面。
美銀預計，勞動市場將繼續保持平衡，2027年每月平均新增非農就業人數約6.4萬人，未來兩年失業率均維持在4.1%。

去全球化讓2%通膨目標更難實現

美銀預計，美國核心個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數年增率將在2027年底降至2.6%，較聯準會9月預測高0.1個百分點，並在2028年底進一步降至2.3%。
在核心通膨預測中，美銀估計，關稅和伊朗衝突（後者主要透過航空票價傳導）對通膨的合計影響約為50個基點，並假設這些影響將在明年逐步退出年增率計算。不過，鑑於名目支出成長仍然強勁，隨著供給衝擊消退，需求帶動的通膨可能有所回升，部分抵銷聯準會升息帶來的通膨降溫效果。
更值得關注的是，美銀認為，即使關稅的通膨效應消退，去全球化趨勢仍可能持續，並繼續對商品價格形成上行壓力。
該行指出，從1994年《北美自由貿易協定》生效至疫情爆發前，美國核心PCE商品價格的年化增速為-0.5%。商品價格長期下降，使聯準會即使在核心服務通膨維持於2.8%左右的情況下，也能將核心PCE通膨控制在2%左右。
然而，自2020年2月以來，核心商品價格的年化增速已升至2%。即使未來這項增速放緩至1%左右，核心服務通膨也需要下降超過1個百分點至2.3%，才能使核心PCE通膨回到2%。
美銀懷疑，在經濟活動不出現大幅放緩的情況下，服務通膨能否實現如此顯著的降溫。
至於整體通膨——根據該行大宗商品研究團隊的油價預測——美銀預計整體PCE通膨將在2027年底降至2.5%。不過，由於整體通膨走勢高度取決於伊朗衝突的發展，該行對這項預測的信心較低。

Fed料連續三次升息 AI投資週期或改變利率路徑

美銀近期新增了2027年1月升息的預測，預計聯準會將在今年12月及明年1月、3月分別升息25個基點，將聯邦資金利率目標區間提高至4.50%至4.75%，並維持至2028年底。
美銀認為，在10月CPI數據公布後，多數聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）成員已經或將會認同兩項判斷：一是10月暫停升息是個錯誤；二是由於貨幣政策已落後於形勢，聯準會已無法再以每季升息一次的節奏推進緊縮。
儘管聯準會理事華勒為12月升息50個基點保留了可能性，但鑑於10月生產者物價指數（PPI）數據略顯疲軟、股市下跌及油價顯著回落，美銀認為連續升息25個基點的可能性更高。報告發布時的市場定價顯示，未來兩次聯準會會議累計升息幅度接近45個基點，其中12月升息50個基點的可能性較小。
不過，AI投資週期可能使聯準會的實際政策路徑顯著偏離基準預測。如果企業投資繼續保持雙位數成長，總需求將進一步增強，工資和物價面臨的上行壓力也將加大。一旦工資增速重新加快、失業率下降，聯準會的就業和物價穩定目標都將指向更緊縮的貨幣政策。持續強勁的資本需求還可能使聯準會認為中性實質利率正在上升，推動政策利率達到5%甚至更高。
反之，如果AI資本支出大幅放緩，股票價格下跌帶來的負向財富效應及就業市場走弱，將共同壓抑居民消費。即使通膨在短期內仍具有黏性，聯準會也可能基於總需求過於疲弱、中性實質利率相對較低的判斷而轉向降息。
此外，2027年上半年的通膨數據也將成為影響貨幣政策的重要因素。2025年12月至2026年5月，美國核心PCE通膨年化增速達到3.9%，且每個月的月增率折年增速均高於3%。隨著這些高通膨月份逐步退出年增率計算區間，如果核心PCE年增率顯著回落，聯準會可能取消或延後明年3月的升息。但如果企業在明年第一季再次進行大幅度的年度價格調整，聯準會仍可能進一步升息，甚至進行單次大幅升息。

AI應用與地緣政治帶來額外風險

除資本支出週期外，美銀還警告，AI應用普及可能導致白領服務業出現大規模職位流失。該行預計，這項風險不會在2027年成為現實，但可能在2028年及以後逐漸成為焦點。
美銀認為，在這種情境下，鑑於聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）的立場偏向寬鬆，聯準會仍將選擇降息。不過，由於技術取代造成的失業屬於結構性失業，而非週期性失業，降息的經濟政策依據並不那麼明確。
日益頻繁的網路攻擊則可能迫使企業放慢AI應用速度，在緩解大規模裁員風險的同時，衝擊AI企業營收，導致資本支出放緩，並對股票和信用市場造成壓力。
伊朗衝突同樣構成雙向風險。美銀指出，過去一年美國居民實質可支配所得僅成長1%，如果能源價格衝擊進一步加劇，實質消費將難以維持目前超過2%的成長速度。相反地，如果衝突獲得解決、能源價格迅速下降，加上股市可能上漲帶來的財富效應，美國國內需求可能顯著增強。

財政赤字與美債殖利率或陷入惡性循環

美銀指出，美國財政問題仍未獲得解決。在基準情境下，該行預計，美國聯邦政府2027財年和2028財年的財政赤字將分別達到2.075兆美元和2.25兆美元，占GDP的比重分別為6.1%和6.4%。
不過，明年美國甚至可能出台更多財政刺激措施。川普政府希望增加國防支出，而民主黨可能同意這項安排，以換取撤回《大而美法案》中的部分醫療補助計畫削減措施。這類政策雖然有利於經濟成長，卻可能使財政赤字在基準預測的基礎上進一步擴大。美銀認為，債券市場最終可能決定美國政府能否實施更多財政刺激，以及刺激措施的規模。
該行警告，即使沒有新增財政刺激，美國債券市場也可能因投資人對財政永續性的擔憂而遭遇拋售。目前，美國聯邦政府淨利息支出占GDP的比重已處於歷史高點，而華府仍缺乏推動財政整頓的意願。
美銀認為，在長期美債殖利率已重新升至5%以上的背景下，美國可能陷入殖利率上升、利息支出增加、財政赤字擴大、殖利率進一步上升的惡性循環，最終對風險性資產價格和經濟活動造成衝擊。
儘管面臨上述風險，美銀目前仍認為美國經濟處於良好狀態。但未來兩年經濟能否延續穩健成長，以及聯準會能否在控制通膨的同時避免經濟衰退，在很大程度上將取決於AI投資浪潮的演變。

items.title: 傳五角大廈曾想動用《國防生產法》讓黃仁勳復職 官方否認
paras: 《華盛頓郵報》週三 (25 日) 報導，美國國防部長海格塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 與五角大廈高層，曾在上週末討論援引《國防生產法》(Defense Production Act)，作為施壓輝達 (NVDA-US) 董事會、促使黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 回任執行長的手段。不過，五角大廈高階官員否認曾有相關討論或提案。
這些討論發生在黃仁勳週一 (23 日) 復職之前。
三名知情人士表示，海格塞斯與副部長費恩伯格 (Steve Feinberg) 等官員，曾研議如何以這項法律作為談判籌碼，推動董事會恢復黃仁勳職務。
他們認為，輝達對美國國家安全至關重要。消息人士因涉及敏感對話，要求匿名。
《國防生產法》於 1950 年制定，賦予美國總統廣泛的經濟干預權力，過去主要用於戰爭或國家緊急狀態期間，動員民間企業提供軍事及其他必要物資。
川普第一任政府也曾在新冠疫情期間援引這項法律，要求通用汽車生產呼吸器。
報導所描述的施壓方式，是透過調整生產優先順序，影響輝達的營運安排。
一名川普政府官員向《華郵》表示：「基本上，他們可以利用《國防生產法》，迫使輝達將更多生產轉向軍事項目。」這可能干擾公司的生產計畫，並衝擊獲利。
至於相關討論是否曾傳達給總統川普或副總統范斯 (JD Vance)，目前仍不清楚，也無法確認五角大廈最終向輝達提出了哪些要求。
另有兩名知情人士告訴《華郵》，川普與范斯逐漸認定，輝達對美國經濟具有重要影響，而黃仁勳具備穩定金融市場的獨特能力。
隨著黃仁勳相關風波拖累股市，川普親自要求范斯介入，協調他重返輝達。
然而，對於上述傳聞，一名不具名的五角大廈高階官員向《華郵》否認：「報導所描述的高層對話從未發生，部長、副部長或次長也未提出任何這類方案。」
黃仁勳已於週一恢復輝達執行長職務。目前報導涉及的是官員是否曾研議以《國防生產法》施壓，並無資訊顯示美國政府已實際援引這項法律，促成此次人事決定。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 上週五重挫 14.01%，週一因黃仁勳復職狂飆 31.48%，隨後兩日累跌 9.54%，週三收 149.30 美元，回吐週一約四成漲幅，仍較復職前高出 18.94%。

items.title: 黃仁勳「失業11天」在幹嘛？曾私訊好友想騎重機橫越美國
items.title_en: Jensen Huang "Unemployed for 11 Days"—What Was He Doing? He Texted a Friend About Riding a Motorcycle Across the U.S.
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 短暫離開執行長職位期間，曾想騎重機橫越美國。美國知名 Podcast 主持人弗里德曼 (Lex Fridman) 透露，黃仁勳上週主動傳訊息，表示想加入他正在進行的公路旅行。如今黃仁勳重返輝達，讓他忍不住感嘆：「真後悔當時沒有答應，現在他又要忙起來了。」
弗里德曼在社群平台 X 發文表示，自己正在騎機車橫越美國，黃仁勳得知後提出加入，兩人可以各騎一輛機車同行。
他坦言，這番話聽起來或許像在開玩笑，但黃仁勳「很可能是認真的」。
不過，這趟結伴旅行還沒成行，黃仁勳便於 23 日恢復輝達總裁、執行長及董事職務，距離請辭僅過 11 天。
弗里德曼未透露兩人是否討論過出發日期或路線，貼文中則流露出錯過邀約的惋惜。
兩人的往來也不只限於節目訪談。
弗里德曼先前曾表示，自己認識黃仁勳已久，兩人還曾在台灣一起逛夜市、品嘗小吃，談論黃仁勳的童年回憶與科技產業。
除了分享重機邀約，弗里德曼也在貼文中聲援黃仁勳，認為世界需要更多像他這樣的領導者。
他直言，許多領袖表現不佳，值得肯定的人應受到保護，並援引馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 的觀點，主張在人陷入低潮時伸出援手，而非落井下石。
弗里德曼表示，每個人都有缺點，也難免犯錯，但人性中的善意比惡意更多，社會應多支持值得肯定的人與事。
談到美中科技競爭，弗里德曼認為，中國應是美國的競爭對手，而非敵人，因為「戰爭帶來破壞，競爭帶來創造」。
他強調，身為美國人，自己希望美國勝出，但應透過良性競爭，而非軍事衝突與局勢升級。
他也提醒外界，應警惕軍工複合體透過煽動仇恨、恐懼與分裂，推升對抗情緒，並將黃仁勳形容為「和平締造者」，認為他對美國在科技競爭中取得成功至關重要。
發文當下，弗里德曼仍在旅途中。
他說，自己正坐在偏遠地區的一處加油站，喝完咖啡、稍作休息後，準備繼續騎車上路，並感嘆騎機車帶來的自由感無可比擬。至於曾想加入的黃仁勳，則已回到輝達，重新投入公司事務。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 上週五重挫 14.01%，週一因黃仁勳復職狂飆 31.48%，隨後兩日累跌 9.54%，週三收 149.30 美元，回吐週一約四成漲幅，仍較復職前高出 18.94%。
paras_en: During a brief period when NVIDIA (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang stepped away from the CEO role, he considered riding a motorcycle across the United States. U.S. podcast host Lex Fridman revealed that last week Huang proactively sent a message expressing his desire to join Fridman's ongoing road trip. Now that Huang has returned to NVIDIA, he cannot help but lament, "I really regret not agreeing back then; now he's busy again."
Fridman posted on X that he was riding a motorcycle across the U.S., and upon learning this, Huang suggested joining him, with the two of them riding separate bikes together.
He admitted that the suggestion might sound like a joke, but Huang "probably was serious."
However, the joint trip never materialized, and on the 23rd Huang resumed his positions as NVIDIA president, CEO, and board member, just 11 days after announcing his resignation.
Fridman did not disclose whether the two discussed a departure date or route; the post expressed regret at missing the invitation.
Their interactions extend beyond interview appearances.

Fridman previously noted that he has known Huang for a long time, and the two once visited night markets and sampled street food in Taiwan, discussing Huang's childhood memories and the tech industry.
In addition to sharing the motorcycle invitation, Fridman also voiced support for Huang, stating that the world needs more leaders like him.

He bluntly said that many leaders perform poorly, and those who deserve recognition should be protected, citing Elon Musk's view that one should lend a hand when people are in a slump rather than throw stones into a pit.
Fridman said everyone has flaws and can make mistakes, but the good in humanity outweighs the bad; society should support those who deserve praise and positive actions.
When discussing U.S.-China tech competition, Fridman believes China should be a competitor, not an enemy, because "war brings destruction, competition brings creation."
He emphasized that as an American, he hopes the U.S. wins, but through healthy competition rather than military conflict or escalation.

He also warned the public to be wary of the military-industrial complex inflaming hatred, fear, and division to heighten antagonism, and described Huang as a "peacemaker," believing he is crucial to U.S. success in tech competition.
At the time of posting, Fridman was still on the road.

He said he was sitting at a remote gas station, finished a cup of coffee, took a short break, and was ready to continue riding, marveling at the incomparable freedom of motorcycling; as for Huang, he had returned to NVIDIA and refocused on company matters.

NVIDIA (NVDA-US) fell 14.01% last Friday, surged 31.48% on Monday after Huang's return, then dropped 9.54% over the next two days, closing at $149.30 on Wednesday, retracting about 40% of Monday's gains but remaining 18.94% above the pre‑resignation level.

items.title: 川普12/4赴亞利桑那州 出席台積電晶片廠擴建動土典禮
items.title_en: Trump to Attend TSMC Arizona Plant Groundbreaking on Dec. 4
paras: 《美聯社》報導，白宮與台灣半導體製造商台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)表示，將經濟政策寄望於AI產業成長的美國總統川普，將於12月4日前往亞利桑那州，出席台積電新晶圓廠的動土典禮。
此次行程正值華府本週密切檢視AI產業之際。此前，川普介入輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)執行長人事，協助黃仁勳重新掌舵。黃仁勳預定12月3日出席參議院銀行委員會聽證會，屆時將面臨議員質詢，內容包括輝達如何向海外銷售晶片，以及他與一名涉嫌中國間諜的女性發生婚外情一事。
台積電近年積極擴大在亞利桑那州鳳凰城一帶的布局，並利用美國廠區為輝達、蘋果(AAPL-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)及高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)等科技公司生產晶片。川普此次將出席台積電亞利桑那州擴建計畫第五期工程的動土典禮。
台積電今年7月宣布，將再投入1,000億美元擴大美國製造產能，使其在美國晶片製造領域承諾的總投資額達到2,650億美元。
隨著人工智慧發展帶動電腦晶片需求增加，加上台灣在晶片製造領域的主導地位，促使包括美國在內的各國正透過提高國內產能，因應供應鏈脆弱性的問題，台積電的投資規模也隨之擴大。
川普一直試圖將這些投資歸功於他的關稅政策，但台積電早在前總統拜登任內，就已開始在亞利桑那州興建廠房。拜登簽署生效的跨黨派「晶片與科學法案」(CHIPS and Science Act)，也為這項計畫提供部分財務支持。
白宮表示，這次擴建計畫預計將創造1萬個直接就業機會，以及在周邊社區新增1.1萬個間接就業機會。目前該廠區已提供超過1.2萬個營建工作機會。
paras_en: The Associated Press reports that the White House and Taiwan semiconductor manufacturer TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) say that U.S. President Donald Trump, who has placed economic policy hopes on the growth of the AI industry, will travel to Arizona on December 4 to attend the groundbreaking ceremony for TSMC’s new wafer plant.

This trip comes as Washington closely examines the AI sector this week. Earlier, Trump intervened in Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO personnel, helping Jensen Huang regain control. Huang is scheduled to appear before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3, where he will face questions from senators about Nvidia’s overseas chip sales and a rumored affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.

TSMC has been actively expanding its footprint around Phoenix, Arizona, and uses its U.S. facilities to produce chips for Nvidia, Apple (AAPL‑US), AMD (AMD‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US). Trump will attend the groundbreaking for Phase 5 of TSMC’s Arizona expansion plan.
In July, TSMC announced it would invest an additional $100 billion to expand U.S. manufacturing capacity, bringing its total U.S. investment pledge to $265 billion.

With AI development driving increased demand for computer chips and Taiwan’s dominance in chip manufacturing, countries including the United States are boosting domestic capacity to address supply‑chain fragility, leading to larger TSMC investment scales.

Trump has long tried to attribute these investments to his tariff policy, but TSMC began building its Arizona plant during former President Biden’s term. Biden signed the bipartisan CHIPS and Science Act, which also provided partial financial support for the project.
The White House says the expansion is expected to create 10,000 direct jobs and add 11,000 indirect jobs in surrounding communities. The site already offers more than 12,000 construction jobs.

items.title: AI信仰遭遇極限壓力測試！美股超級「V轉」 分析師：深V不是轉折  是分歧
items.title_en: AI Faith Faces Extreme Pressure Test! US Stocks Super “V-Shape” Analysts: Deep V Is Not a Turning Point but a Divergence
paras: 華爾街週三(25日)上演一場「驚魂深V」劇本，盤中恐慌式殺盤，尾盤硬拉收回，但市場情緒的底層邏輯已經換了。
那斯達克100指數(NDX) 開盤5分鐘便重挫近5%，那斯達克指數一度跌約4.5%，標普500盤中跌超3%、道瓊指數(DJI) 一度狂瀉逾1100點，費城半導體(SOX)跌近8%，輝達(NVDA-US) 盤中一度跌近9%，隨後跌幅全數收斂，道瓊翻紅收漲0.33%，標普僅跌0.25%，那指收跌0.62%。
金銀同步演「超級V」，現貨金價盤中最低見到每盎司3426美元，尾盤拉回漲0.92%收3588.41美元，白銀盤中跌超6%，收漲1.15%至41.38美元。
兩天前白宮推動黃仁勳復任輝達執行長，曾讓AI鏈單日暴漲、那指漲超6%，但這波「情緒紓困」沒撐過一日遊。
Running Oak Capital執行長Seth Cogswell直言：「這試圖成為一次AI行業紓困，但沒奏效，人們看穿了。」
更麻煩的是治理溢價被撕開。標普全球評級週三將輝達AA評級列入「負面觀察」，指黃仁勳離任又復職暴露董事會獨立性、接班計畫與監督機制漏洞，90天內可能降至AA-，輝達週三收跌3.91%，CDS違約保護成本創新高。
真正壓抑風險偏好的，是敘事切換。Solstein Capital執行長Terman說：「市場不再爭論AI會不會改變世界，而在問誰能賺錢、能賺多少、數兆美元資本開支能不能回收。諷刺的是，技術承諾兌現了，財務回報卻可能讓投資人失望。」
聯準會(Fed)重啟緊縮讓這道題更尖銳：融資成本抬升，資料中心、HBM、算力租賃的ROI必須更高才合理。期中選舉後民主黨對資料中心擴張的阻力、出口管制不確定性，再疊一層政策折現風險。
NYSE交易廳老將Jonathan Corpina把當前市場情緒跟2008年時類比說道：「不是拋售規模一樣，是那種『接下來還會怎樣』的持續不安。」
TradeMas交易員Peter Tuchman則說：「從未見過同一個故事——英偉達——讓市場看法反轉得這麼徹底。」
分析師指出，拋售「有序」，獲利與宏觀底子還在，但盤面已變成情緒博弈。
Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek苦笑說：「過去10天搖頭次數太多，脖子都酸了。」他客戶最怕的不是繼續跌，而是「萬一反彈踏空」。
深V不是轉折，是分歧。AI技術前景不再是最大爭議，「數兆美元投入能否變成足夠獲利、市場還願不願續費」才是定價核心。短期看Fed態度與輝達治理修補，中期看雲廠資本開支回報，這一輪洗盤後，留下的只會是最有信念、也最會算帳的資金。
paras_en: Wall Street staged a “deep V” drama on Wednesday (25th), with panic selling in the middle of the day and a hard pullback at the close, but the underlying market logic had already shifted.

The Nasdaq 100 (NDX) fell nearly 5% in the first five minutes of trading, the Nasdaq index briefly dropped about 4.5%, the S&P 500 fell over 3% mid‑day, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJI) plunged more than 1,100 points, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) fell nearly 8%, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped almost 9% mid‑day before the declines converged; the Dow ended up 0.33% higher, the S&P only down 0.25%, and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.

Gold and silver both performed a “super V,” with spot gold hitting a low of $3,426 per ounce mid‑day and rebounding 0.92% to close at $3,588.41, while silver fell over 6% mid‑day and closed up 1.15% at $41.38.

Two days ago the White House pushed for Jensen Huang’s reappointment as Nvidia CEO, which once caused a one‑day surge in AI stocks and a 6% rise in the Nasdaq, but this “emotional relief” did not last beyond the day.
Running Oak Capital CEO Seth Cogswell bluntly said, “This was an attempt to provide a bailout for the AI industry, but it failed; people see through it.”

Complicating matters further, governance premiums were ripped apart. S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia’s AA rating under “negative watch” on Wednesday, citing that Huang’s departure and return exposed board independence, succession planning, and oversight mechanism weaknesses, with a possible downgrade to AA‑ within 90 days. Nvidia fell 3.91% on Wednesday and CDS default protection costs hit a new high.

The real risk‑aversion comes from a narrative shift. Solstein Capital CEO Terman said, “The market no longer debates whether AI will change the world; it asks who can make money, how much, and whether the trillions of dollars in capital spend can be recouped. Ironically, the technology promise has been fulfilled, but financial returns may disappoint investors.”

The Fed’s re‑tightening makes this issue sharper: financing costs rise, and the ROI for data centers, HBM, and compute‑as‑a‑service must be higher to be justified. After the midterm election, Democratic resistance to data‑center expansion, export‑control uncertainty, and additional policy discount risk stack on.
NYSE veteran Jonathan Corpina compared the current market sentiment to 2008, saying, “It’s not the same scale of selling, but the persistent unease about ‘what will happen next’.”
TradeMas trader Peter Tuchman said, “I’ve never seen the same story—Nvidia—flip market sentiment so thoroughly.”
Analysts noted that the sell‑off is “ordered,” profits and macro fundamentals remain, but the market has become an emotional game.

Siebert Financial CIO Mark Malek grimaced, “We’ve been shaking our heads too many times in the past 10 days; our necks are sore.” He said his clients fear not a continued decline but a missed rebound if they sell too early.

The deep V is not a turning point but a divergence. The future of AI technology is no longer the biggest debate; the question is whether trillions of dollars of investment can generate sufficient profit and whether the market will continue to pay for it. In the short term, Fed stance and Nvidia governance fixes matter; in the midterm, cloud‑provider capital‑spend returns will determine the outcome. After this round of market cleaning, only the most committed and financially savvy investors will remain.

items.title: 星巴克、瑞幸扎堆入局 飲品開始在中國拚高蛋白了
items.title_en: Starbucks, Luckin Crowd into the Market as Drinks in China Compete for High Protein
paras: 今年以來，高蛋白飲品站上風口。
今年4月，星巴克(SBUX-US) 中國宣布在全國門市推出高蛋白拿鐵PRO系列，高蛋白被單獨做成新的菜單入口。隨後又推出高蛋白馥芮白PRO、太妃榛果高蛋白拿鐵等多款飲品。
星巴克中國首席增長官楊振表示，這是繼去年「真味無糖」創新平台後，針對消費者日益增長的健康需求的又一布局。
星巴克並非孤例。皮爺咖啡、COSTA咖世家、拉瓦薩（Lavazza）咖啡、瑞幸等先後推出高蛋白飲品。
另一邊，肯德基子品牌KPRO推出肯律輕食，伊利推出透明蛋白水，盒馬擺出蛋白質水。
《21世紀經濟報導》26日指出，同樣是高蛋白，品牌賣的不是同一種生意。
星巴克、皮爺、拉瓦薩和COSTA的布局，更像是一場奶咖溢價保衛戰。
過去幾年，現製咖啡價格一路下探，團購券、外賣補貼和人民幣9.9元促銷不斷擠壓一杯奶咖的定價空間。高蛋白奶、0乳糖、原生乳蛋白，給了中高端咖啡一個新的溢價解釋。
消費者支付的不是更貴的牛奶，而是一份可以兼顧提神和營養補給的早餐。
瑞幸、KPRO和奈雪爭奪的則是「飲品之外的一餐」。
KPRO原本就擁有輕食、健身和控卡客群，高蛋白酸奶昔可以自然嵌入套餐；奈雪在海外店把蛋白與牛油果、莓果、益生菌組合，試圖讓一杯茶飲具備更強代餐屬性。
這些飲食真正的對手，不只是同行新品，還有便利商店沙拉、優格、蛋白棒和簡餐。
第三類玩家不在門市，而在貨架和供應鏈上。
蒙牛M-PLUS每日蛋白牛乳每瓶250毫升含15克原生乳蛋白；一個月後，M-PLUS又上架15克蛋白低溫益生菌酸奶。
伊利則把乳清蛋白做成了「透明蛋白水」。Puritime每瓶300毫升含9克分離乳清蛋白。京東七鮮與ffit8又聯合推出330毫升膠原蛋白肽水，每瓶添加不少於6克膠原蛋白肽。盒馬的蛋白質水則以500毫升、12.5克分離乳清蛋白切入貨架。
這構成了一個清晰高蛋白飲品賽道。乳企和零售商先把蛋白原料、口感和價格帶跑出來。連鎖飲品店再把它翻譯成早餐、午餐、下午茶和運動補給。
同時，茶飲、乳業品牌對高蛋白賽道的未來格外看好。蒙牛董事會副主席、執行董事兼總裁高飛曾表示，希望蒙牛M-PLUS每日蛋白牛乳這一產品成為「特侖蘇之後的又一個大單品」。
茶百道在2024年ESG報告中已將高蛋白列為低糖、低熱量之外的健康化定製方向；蜜雪冰城與悅鮮活則宣布圍繞高蛋白聯合研發。
paras_en: This year, high‑protein drinks have taken the spotlight.

In April, Starbucks (SBUX‑US) China announced the nationwide launch of the high‑protein latte PRO series, creating a new menu entry for high protein. It was followed by the high‑protein Frappuccino PRO, caramel hazelnut high‑protein latte, and several other drinks.
Starbucks China’s chief growth officer, Yang Zhen, said this is another move to meet consumers’ growing health demands, following last year’s “True Taste Unsweetened” innovation platform.
Starbucks is not alone. Papa Coffee, COSTA, Lavazza, and Luckin have all introduced high‑protein drinks.
Meanwhile, KFC’s sub‑brand KPRO launched K‑Lyu light meals, Yili released transparent protein water, and Hema offered protein water.
The 21st Century Economic Report on the 26th noted that, although all are high‑protein, the brands are selling different kinds of business.
Starbucks, Papa, Lavazza, and COSTA’s strategy resembles a premium defense of milk‑based coffee.

In recent years, the price of freshly brewed coffee has fallen, with group‑purchase coupons, delivery subsidies, and 9.9‑yuan promotions squeezing the pricing space for a cup of milk coffee. High‑protein milk, lactose‑free, and native milk protein provide a new premium justification for mid‑to‑high‑end coffee.
Consumers are paying not for more expensive milk, but for a breakfast that can both wake them up and provide nutritional support.
Luckin, KPRO, and Naixue are competing for a “meal outside of drinks.”

KPRO already has a light‑food, fitness, and calorie‑control customer base, so high‑protein yogurt smoothies can naturally fit into a meal set; Naixue combines protein with avocado, berries, and probiotics in overseas stores, aiming to give a tea drink stronger meal‑replacement attributes.
These real competitors are not just new products from peers, but also convenience‑store salads, yogurts, protein bars, and quick meals.
The third group of players is not in stores, but on shelves and supply chains.
Mengniu’s M‑PLUS Daily Protein Milk, 250‑ml bottles contain 15 g of native milk protein; a month later, M‑PLUS launched a 15‑g protein low‑temperature probiotic yogurt.

Yili turned whey protein into “transparent protein water.” Puritime’s 300‑ml bottle contains 9 g of isolated whey protein. JD’s Qishen and ffit8 jointly launched a 330‑ml collagen peptide water, adding at least 6 g of collagen peptides per bottle. Hema’s protein water entered the shelf with 500‑ml bottles containing 12.5 g of isolated whey protein.

This creates a clear high‑protein beverage track. Dairy companies and retailers first bring protein raw materials, taste, and price to market. Chain beverage stores then translate them into breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and sports nutrition.

At the same time, tea and dairy brands are very optimistic about the future of the high‑protein track. Mengniu’s board deputy chairman, executive director, and president Gao Fei said he hopes Mengniu M‑PLUS Daily Protein Milk will become “another big single product after Telenor.”
Tea Baidao listed high protein as a health‑customization direction beyond low sugar and low calorie in its 2024 ESG report; Mixue Bingcheng and Yuexianhu announced joint R&D around high protein.

items.title: Palantir CEO：AI恐加劇貧富差距、傷害中產階級！企業數據主權成關鍵
items.title_en: Palantir CEO: AI Could Worsen Wealth Gap, Harm Middle Class! Corporate Data Sovereignty Becomes Key
paras: Palantir(PLTR-US)執行長Alexander Karp近日接受深度專訪，談及AI快速發展背後的社會代價、企業數據主權、政府監控界線，以及科技產業應承擔的國防與社會責任。Karp警告，AI雖然有望創造大量新工作機會，卻也可能讓技術從業者與一般勞動者之間的財富差距進一步擴大，甚至傷害中產階級。他主張，企業必須掌握自身核心數據，不能任由外部AI模型取得專有資訊；政府也應對軍用AI的使用範圍設下明確限制。
這場對話不僅揭示Karp對AI經濟與政治影響的深層憂慮，也回溯他的原生家庭、閱讀障礙與「局外人」經歷，說明這些背景如何形塑Palantir有別於矽谷主流的產品哲學，以及他對科技、資本主義與人類價值的獨特看法。
圍繞隱私與安全，Karp把商業數據控制、監控和戰場技術區分開來。他認為，年輕人警惕政府，卻低估商業平台透過數據與資訊分發影響個人思想的能力；合法授權下的執法與無邊界監控，存在政治、道德和技術上的本質區別。AI是一種可被用於不同目的的「原材料」，因此必須限制技術濫用，尤其應立法禁止軍用級AI轉作監控，同時保留法治、授權到期後的數據處理和個人權利保護機制。
在AI經濟影響上，Karp既相信新技術會創造工作機會，也警告財富分配可能進一步失衡。普通勞動者即使工資漲幅達到通膨率的兩倍，也可能追不上技術從業者10倍、20倍乃至50倍的財富增長。他支持富人多承擔稅負，卻反對直接徵收財富稅，理由是資產流動性、科技創業激勵和政府監控擴張；其替代思路是把增稅與政府浪費削減綁定，讓公共資源真正改善貧困者和工薪階層的生活。
對話還觸及企業數據主權、矽谷的國防責任以及人類價值。Karp認為，企業不能一邊付費購買大型模型服務，一邊在缺乏保護的情況下讓核心專有數據成為外部模型的訓練資源；Palantir的「本體」既要將數據轉化為業務價值，也要成為安全邊界。最後，當機器在認知能力上超越人類時，人的價值不能再僅建立在智力之上，而應落在藝術性、個體性、獨特性以及應受保護的權利之上。
以下為訪談重點：

「局外人」視角是Karp的產品方法。閱讀障礙讓他不易照搬主流文化的語言體系，原生家庭與成長經歷則強化了他對既有體制的審慎和不依賴現成答案的習慣。
Palantir曾以約三年零收入換取真實產品價值。Karp反對先做低價值、易依賴的產品，再靠大量銷售推廣；他當年對價值的定義是同時阻止恐怖襲擊並保護公民自由。
偉大建造者需要技術之外的審美與判斷。賈伯斯、馬斯克等人的共同點，是局外人身份、人文審美與商業敏銳度的結合，而非單純技術能力。
商業平台的數據集中同樣值得警惕。個人觀點並非完全獨立形成，而是在自身思想與外部資訊之間持續互動；少數公司若控制數據和資訊入口，就可能深刻影響認知。
合法授權與無邊界監控必須區分。系統不僅要符合法律程序，還應在技術層面支持授權期限、數據保留與刪除等約束；Karp同時承認，授權範圍、誤用和申訴仍需制度監督。
戰場AI不應直接轉作國內監控。Karp主張透過立法劃清邊界，並把不受約束的「零犯罪」社會視為危險信號：過度治理最先傷害的可能是獨立思想和偏離常態的人。
AI創造就業不等於縮小貧富差距。新工作機會和再培訓可能改善部分勞動者的處境，但財富增長速度的差異仍會擴大相對不平等，並削弱社會共識。
Karp支持富人多繳稅，但反對財富稅。他擔憂存量財富估值帶來的隱私侵入和非流動資產壓力，提出以遺產稅等方式增稅，並綁定政府浪費削減。
「本體」同時承擔價值創造與數據保護。它把零散數據放入業務語境，使AI轉化為可落地價值；同時透過權限、合同和治理機制，降低專有數據外洩或被外部模型利用的風險。
矽谷不能只享受國家體系的紅利而逃避責任。Karp認為，大學、政府、軍方與創投共同塑造了矽谷，科技公司應重新回答財富創造是否真正改善普通人的生活。
資本主義更優，但不是萬能藥。它解決了其他制度難以解決的問題，也會產生財富錯配、權力失衡與社會撕裂等負外部性，不能被視為解決一切問題的教條。
機器超越認知後，人性更需被保護。人的價值不僅是語言和計算能力，更包括藝術創造、個體性、獨特性與基本權利，這些應成為AI時代法律與文化的底線。
paras_en: Palantir (PLTR-US) CEO Alexander Karp recently gave an in‑depth interview discussing the social costs of AI’s rapid development, corporate data sovereignty, the line of government surveillance, and the defense and social responsibilities that the tech industry must shoulder. Karp warned that while AI may create many new jobs, it could also widen the wealth gap between tech workers and ordinary laborers, even harming the middle class. He argued that companies must control their core data and not allow external AI models to access proprietary information, and that governments should set clear limits on the use of military AI.

The conversation not only revealed Karp’s deep concerns about AI’s economic and political impacts, but also traced his upbringing, dyslexia, and outsider experience, explaining how these backgrounds shaped Palantir’s product philosophy distinct from mainstream Silicon Valley and his unique views on technology, capitalism, and human values.

Regarding privacy and security, Karp distinguished commercial data control, surveillance, and battlefield technology. He believes young people are wary of government but underestimate how commercial platforms can influence personal thought through data and information distribution. He says that law‑authorized policing and borderless surveillance differ politically, morally, and technically. AI is a raw material that can be used for different purposes, so misuse must be restricted, especially by legislation banning the conversion of military‑grade AI to surveillance, while preserving rule‑of‑law, post‑authorization data handling, and personal rights protections.

On AI’s economic impact, Karp both believes new technology will create jobs and warns that wealth distribution may become even more imbalanced. Even if ordinary workers’ wages rise twice the inflation rate, they may still lag behind tech workers whose wealth grows ten, twenty, or even fifty times faster. He supports higher taxes for the wealthy but opposes a direct wealth tax, citing concerns about asset liquidity, tech entrepreneurship incentives, and government surveillance expansion. His alternative is to tie tax increases to cuts in government waste, so public resources truly improve the lives of the poor and wage earners.

The dialogue also touched on corporate data sovereignty, Silicon Valley’s defense responsibilities, and human values. Karp says companies cannot pay for large‑model services while letting core proprietary data become training resources for external models without protection. Palantir’s “ontology” must turn data into business value and also serve as a security boundary. Finally, when machines surpass human cognitive abilities, human value can no longer rest solely on intellect but must be grounded in artistry, individuality, uniqueness, and protected rights.

The interview highlights include: the outsider perspective as Karp’s product approach; dyslexia making it hard to copy mainstream cultural language; his family and upbringing reinforcing caution toward existing systems and a habit of not relying on ready answers; Palantir’s early years trading three years of no revenue for real product value; Karp’s opposition to low‑value, easily dependent products sold in volume; his definition of value as simultaneously preventing terrorist attacks and protecting civil liberties; the need for aesthetic judgment beyond technology for great builders; the similarity among outsiders like Jobs and Musk in combining humanistic aesthetics with business acuity; the warning that data concentration on commercial platforms can profoundly shape cognition; the necessity to distinguish lawful authorization from borderless surveillance; the argument that battlefield AI should not be directly repurposed for domestic surveillance; the view that AI job creation does not reduce inequality; Karp’s support for higher taxes on the wealthy but opposition to wealth tax; his concern about privacy intrusion from wealth valuation and non‑liquid assets; his proposal to raise taxes via inheritance tax tied to waste cuts; the dual role of the ontology in value creation and data protection; the call that Silicon Valley cannot simply enjoy national system benefits while evading responsibility; the belief that capitalism is better but not a cure‑all; and the assertion that after machines surpass cognition, human nature must be protected, with value extending beyond language and computation to art, individuality, uniqueness, and fundamental rights as the legal and cultural floor in the AI age.

The seventh paragraph is a continuation of the interview highlights, reiterating Karp’s points on data sovereignty, defense responsibility, and human values, and emphasizing the need for Silicon Valley to answer whether wealth creation truly improves ordinary people’s lives.

items.title: SpaceX大手筆送股！每個活躍川普帳戶獲1股 馬斯克再加碼1股
items.title_en: SpaceX Makes Generous Stock Donation! Each Active Trump Account Receives 1 Share, Musk Adds 1 Share
paras: SpaceX周三 (25日) 宣布，將向每一個目前處於活躍狀態的「川普帳戶」(Trump Account) 捐贈1股新發行的A類普通股，執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 也將以個人名義配捐同等數量的股票，讓更多美國兒童有機會持有這家太空公司的股權。
SpaceX在聲明中表示，公司正致力打造未來基礎設施，推動人類實現跨行星生活，並認為創造這些系統的企業，其所有權應延伸至下一代美國人，讓年輕世代也能分享長期發展成果。
白宮今年10月曾表示，目前已有近7,000萬個川普帳戶完成創建，其中超過6,000萬個是透過自動註冊方式建立。不過，這些帳戶中究竟有多少符合SpaceX所稱的「活躍」狀態，目前仍不清楚。
根據TrumpAccounts.gov網站說明，符合資格的兒童帳戶必須經過認領，才能接受親友及雇主供款，並領取政府提供的1,000美元種子資金。不過，即使自動註冊的帳戶尚未經認領，仍可接受慈善捐贈。
SpaceX與美國財政部代表尚未立即回覆外界對捐贈計畫細節的詢問，因此實際發放時間、股票分配方式，以及「活躍帳戶」的具體認定標準，目前都還沒有明確答案。
這並非SpaceX高層首次向川普帳戶捐贈股票。公司總裁暨營運長蕭特薇爾 (Gwynne Shotwell) 先前已宣布，將以個人名義捐出逾200萬股，符合資格的帳戶持有人預計在12月收到相關捐贈。
馬斯克今年10月也曾在旗下社群平台X發文預告，明年將送給全美每名兒童1股SpaceX股票。此次SpaceX宣布的公司捐贈計畫，加上馬斯克個人配捐，進一步擴大了這項股權贈與計畫的規模。
川普帳戶又稱530A帳戶，開放所有未滿18歲、持有社會安全號碼的美國兒童設立。親友每年最多可為每名兒童存入5,000美元稅後資金，供款期限原則上持續至受益人年滿18歲前一年的年底。
自2027年起，年度供款上限將依通膨調整。自今年7月4日計畫上線以來，親友存入帳戶的金額已超過10億美元，帳戶總存款則突破90億美元。
此外，2025年至2028年出生的兒童，可獲得美國財政部一次性提供的1,000美元資金，符合特定條件者還可能取得其他款項。
美國財政部9月底公布的暫行規定，也允許川普帳戶持有受贈股票，政策目的是鼓勵慈善捐股。相較於出售已增值股票後再捐出現金，捐贈股票可讓捐贈者避免因出售資產而觸發資本利得稅。
不過，依照財政部規定，家庭無法拒收捐入帳戶的股票，相關股票原則上必須持有至少5年，或持有至受益人滿17歲當年年底，兩者以較早到達的時間為準，之後才能出售。
另一方面，SpaceX近期也面臨股權與企業整合相關議題。該公司據報正與馬斯克旗下電動車製造商特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US) 洽談可能的合併案，雙方已分別成立兩個特別委員會處理談判，並聘請顧問評估這項潛在大型交易。
paras_en: SpaceX announced on Wednesday (the 25th) that it will donate one share of newly issued Class A common stock to every currently active "Trump Account," and CEO Elon Musk will personally match that donation with an equal number of shares, giving more American children the chance to own equity in the space company.

In a statement, SpaceX said it is committed to building future infrastructure, advancing humanity’s ability to live on other planets, and believes that companies creating these systems should extend ownership to the next generation of Americans so that young people can share in the long‑term benefits of development.

The White House said in October that nearly 70 million Trump Accounts have been created, more than 60 million of which were set up via automatic registration. However, it is still unclear how many of those accounts meet SpaceX’s definition of "active."

According to TrumpAccounts.gov, eligible child accounts must be claimed before they can receive contributions from relatives, friends, or employers and can receive a $1,000 seed grant from the government. Even if an automatically registered account has not yet been claimed, it can still receive charitable donations.

SpaceX and representatives from the U.S. Treasury have not yet responded to inquiries about the donation plan’s details, so the actual distribution timeline, allocation method, and specific criteria for an "active account" remain unclear.

This is not the first time SpaceX executives have donated stock to Trump Accounts. President and COO Gwynne Shotwell previously announced she would personally donate over 2 million shares, with eligible account holders expected to receive the donations in December.

Musk also announced in October on his social‑media platform X that next year he would give every child in the U.S. one share of SpaceX stock. The company’s donation plan, combined with Musk’s personal match, further expands the scale of the equity gifting program.

Trump Accounts, also known as 530A accounts, allow any U.S. child under 18 with a Social Security number to open an account. Relatives and friends can contribute up to $5,000 after tax per child each year, and contributions can continue in principle until the end of the year before the beneficiary turns 18.

Starting in 2027, the annual contribution limit will be adjusted for inflation. Since the plan went live on July 4th of this year, relatives have deposited more than $1 billion, and total account balances have surpassed $9 billion.
Children born between 2025 and 2028 are eligible for a one‑time $1,000 grant from the Treasury, and those meeting certain conditions may receive additional funds.

The Treasury’s interim rules released at the end of September also allow Trump Accounts to hold donated shares, with the policy aimed at encouraging charitable stock gifts. Compared to selling appreciated stock and donating cash, donating stock lets donors avoid triggering capital gains tax from selling the asset.

However, under Treasury rules, families cannot refuse donated shares, which must be held for at least five years or until the beneficiary turns 17 at the end of that year—whichever comes first—before they can be sold.

Meanwhile, SpaceX has recently faced issues related to equity and corporate integration. Reports say the company is negotiating a possible merger with Musk’s electric‑vehicle manufacturer Tesla (TSLA‑US), with each side having formed a special committee to handle negotiations and hired advisors to evaluate the potential large‑scale deal.

items.title: 美國擬對主要貿易夥伴加徵新關稅 歐盟強烈反對
items.title_en: U.S. Plans New Tariffs on Major Trading Partners, EU Strongly Opposes
paras: 美國政府25日宣布，計劃對主要貿易夥伴的產品加徵新一輪關稅，理由是這些國家和地區通過補貼扶持本國產業，造成工業產能過剩，損害美國企業利益。
根據美國政府公布的方案，歐盟商品關稅稅率將從10%提高至15%。
不過，這些新關稅尚未立即生效。美國政府將留出一個月時間，供公眾和企業以書面形式提交意見。
美國貿易代表格里爾25日接受《CNBC》採訪時表示，美國此次提出的是一系列針對性關稅措施，旨在應對產能過剩問題。
這輪關稅措施源於格里爾今年3月啟動的一項調查。美國貿易代表辦公室認為，包括歐盟在內的約15個貿易夥伴，通過補貼支持本國產業，導致工業產品產量過剩，對美國企業造成不利影響。
這些新關稅將疊加在美國7月底宣布的關稅之上。當時，美國以打擊強迫勞動為由，宣布對約60個國家的產品徵收至少10%額外關稅。
美國將歐盟列入新關稅目標名單，歐盟委員會發言人25日表示，歐方堅決反對，並質疑美國此次加徵關稅的合理性。
美國認為，歐盟推動再工業化的政策、非關稅壁壘，以及通過投資銀行向特定行業提供貸款等做法，構成了將歐盟納入調查範圍的理由。
不過，根據美國貿易代表辦公室提出的方案，新關稅稅率不會超過美國此前與相關貿易夥伴達成的貿易協議所允許的水準。因此，與7月底以來已經實施的額外關稅相比，此次調整幅度相對有限。
美國最高法院今年2月判定取消部分關稅措施後，白宮試圖通過新的法律依據重新實施關稅，並希望使其在法律層面更站得住腳。
paras_en: The U.S. government announced on the 25th that it plans to impose a new round of tariffs on products from major trading partners, arguing that these countries and regions subsidize their own industries, creating excess industrial capacity that harms U.S. corporate interests.
According to the U.S. government’s proposal, the tariff rate on EU goods will rise from 10% to 15%.
However, the new tariffs will not take effect immediately. The U.S. government will allow a one‑month period for the public and businesses to submit written comments.
U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Tai told CNBC in an interview on the 25th that the measures constitute a series of targeted tariffs aimed at addressing excess capacity.

The tariff round stems from an investigation launched by Tai in March. The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative believes that about 15 trading partners, including the EU, subsidize their domestic industries, leading to overproduction of industrial goods and adverse effects on U.S. firms.

These new tariffs will be added on top of those announced at the end of July, when the United States imposed at least a 10% additional duty on products from roughly 60 countries on the grounds of combating forced labor.
The EU was placed on the new tariff target list, and an EU Commission spokesperson said on the 25th that Europe firmly opposes the move and questions the justification for the U.S. tariffs.

The United States argues that the EU’s push for re‑industrialization, non‑tariff barriers, and the provision of loans to specific sectors through investment banks constitute reasons to include the EU in the investigation.

Nevertheless, the proposal from the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative states that the new tariff rates will not exceed the levels permitted under existing trade agreements with the relevant partners, so the adjustment is relatively modest compared with the extra duties already in place since late July.

After the Supreme Court ruled in February that certain tariff measures had to be lifted, the White House is seeking to re‑impose tariffs on a new legal basis, hoping to make them more defensible under the law.

items.title: 美銀2027年展望：AI投資成美國經濟最大變數 Fed料再升息三次
paras: 美銀全球研究11月24日發布「2027年美國經濟展望」報告指出，在企業投資和居民消費支撐下，美國實質GDP預計將在2027年和2028年分別成長2.3%和2.1%，但通膨仍將高於聯準會(Fed)目標。該行預計，聯準會將在接下來三次會議上各升息25個基點，而AI資本支出週期是上述預測面臨的最大不確定性。
美銀認為，AI產業的規模經濟特徵容易導致「理性過度投資」。這個領域最終可能只有少數企業勝出，但每家企業都不得不按照自己將成為贏家的假設進行投資。即使個別企業的投資決策具有合理性，整個產業仍可能出現過度投資。目前最關鍵的問題是，這波資本支出週期何時出現轉折。
據美銀測算，自2025年第一季以來，美國軟體、資料中心、電腦及周邊設備等AI相關資本支出項目的實質年化增速約為26%。
這項高增速存在兩種截然不同的解讀：一是AI投資浪潮的整體規模超出先前預期；二是大量投資被提前執行，意味著未來資本支出可能更早出現大幅下滑，且下滑程度更為劇烈。美銀認為，近期經濟數據尚不足以判斷哪種情況更接近現實。
在基準情境下，美銀預計企業投資至少在2027年上半年保持強勁，隨後逐步放緩。美國實質非住宅投資增速預計將從2026年的7.6%降至2027年的7.0%，並在2028年進一步降至2.9%。按季增率折年率計算，非住宅投資增速預計將從2027年第一季的6.3%降至第四季的2.9%，並在2028年各季維持在2.3%。該行並未在基準預測中納入投資萎縮的情境，主要是因為難以判斷其發生時間。
美銀認為，美國期中選舉結果不會顯著改變其資本支出展望。即使部分州政府出台措施放緩資料中心建設，新規也需要時間才能影響經濟活動，而避免投資過度提前，反而可能降低未來的經濟衰退風險。
美銀還指出，由於企業發布投資指引與相關變化反映在GDP數據中存在時間差，金融市場可能在資本支出實際大幅下滑之前就提前反映，但期間也可能多次發出錯誤訊號。如何區分真正的週期轉折與市場雜訊，將是經濟學家和投資人面臨的一大挑戰。

居民消費仍具韌性 高低收入群體消費增速差距逆轉

除企業投資外，居民消費仍是美國經濟成長的另一大支柱。美銀預計，2027年和2028年美國實質居民消費將分別成長2.3%和2.2%。
儘管今年美國經濟遭遇能源價格衝擊，但財政刺激、AI繁榮帶來的股票財富效應以及就業成長改善，使居民消費展現顯著韌性。
值得注意的是，美國銀行內部信用卡和簽帳金融卡數據顯示，最近數週，低收入家庭扣除汽油支出後的戶均銀行卡消費年增率持續超過高收入家庭，此前高收入家庭消費增速領先的局面，在該行樣本數據中出現逆轉。
展望2027年，美銀認為，能源價格持平或下降帶來的整體通膨回落，將成為實質消費成長最重要的有利因素。美國社會安全福利的生活成本調整幅度，也將從今年1月的2.8%升至明年1月的3.6%。
與此同時，隨著《大而美法案》中的醫療補助計畫削減措施逐步加大力道，以及關稅退款效應消退，財政政策對經濟成長的邊際影響將轉為輕微負面。
美銀預計，勞動市場將繼續保持平衡，2027年每月平均新增非農就業人數約6.4萬人，未來兩年失業率均維持在4.1%。

去全球化讓2%通膨目標更難實現

美銀預計，美國核心個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數年增率將在2027年底降至2.6%，較聯準會9月預測高0.1個百分點，並在2028年底進一步降至2.3%。
在核心通膨預測中，美銀估計，關稅和伊朗衝突（後者主要透過航空票價傳導）對通膨的合計影響約為50個基點，並假設這些影響將在明年逐步退出年增率計算。不過，鑑於名目支出成長仍然強勁，隨著供給衝擊消退，需求帶動的通膨可能有所回升，部分抵銷聯準會升息帶來的通膨降溫效果。
更值得關注的是，美銀認為，即使關稅的通膨效應消退，去全球化趨勢仍可能持續，並繼續對商品價格形成上行壓力。
該行指出，從1994年《北美自由貿易協定》生效至疫情爆發前，美國核心PCE商品價格的年化增速為-0.5%。商品價格長期下降，使聯準會即使在核心服務通膨維持於2.8%左右的情況下，也能將核心PCE通膨控制在2%左右。
然而，自2020年2月以來，核心商品價格的年化增速已升至2%。即使未來這項增速放緩至1%左右，核心服務通膨也需要下降超過1個百分點至2.3%，才能使核心PCE通膨回到2%。
美銀懷疑，在經濟活動不出現大幅放緩的情況下，服務通膨能否實現如此顯著的降溫。
至於整體通膨——根據該行大宗商品研究團隊的油價預測——美銀預計整體PCE通膨將在2027年底降至2.5%。不過，由於整體通膨走勢高度取決於伊朗衝突的發展，該行對這項預測的信心較低。

Fed料連續三次升息 AI投資週期或改變利率路徑

美銀近期新增了2027年1月升息的預測，預計聯準會將在今年12月及明年1月、3月分別升息25個基點，將聯邦資金利率目標區間提高至4.50%至4.75%，並維持至2028年底。
美銀認為，在10月CPI數據公布後，多數聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）成員已經或將會認同兩項判斷：一是10月暫停升息是個錯誤；二是由於貨幣政策已落後於形勢，聯準會已無法再以每季升息一次的節奏推進緊縮。
儘管聯準會理事華勒為12月升息50個基點保留了可能性，但鑑於10月生產者物價指數（PPI）數據略顯疲軟、股市下跌及油價顯著回落，美銀認為連續升息25個基點的可能性更高。報告發布時的市場定價顯示，未來兩次聯準會會議累計升息幅度接近45個基點，其中12月升息50個基點的可能性較小。
不過，AI投資週期可能使聯準會的實際政策路徑顯著偏離基準預測。如果企業投資繼續保持雙位數成長，總需求將進一步增強，工資和物價面臨的上行壓力也將加大。一旦工資增速重新加快、失業率下降，聯準會的就業和物價穩定目標都將指向更緊縮的貨幣政策。持續強勁的資本需求還可能使聯準會認為中性實質利率正在上升，推動政策利率達到5%甚至更高。
反之，如果AI資本支出大幅放緩，股票價格下跌帶來的負向財富效應及就業市場走弱，將共同壓抑居民消費。即使通膨在短期內仍具有黏性，聯準會也可能基於總需求過於疲弱、中性實質利率相對較低的判斷而轉向降息。
此外，2027年上半年的通膨數據也將成為影響貨幣政策的重要因素。2025年12月至2026年5月，美國核心PCE通膨年化增速達到3.9%，且每個月的月增率折年增速均高於3%。隨著這些高通膨月份逐步退出年增率計算區間，如果核心PCE年增率顯著回落，聯準會可能取消或延後明年3月的升息。但如果企業在明年第一季再次進行大幅度的年度價格調整，聯準會仍可能進一步升息，甚至進行單次大幅升息。

AI應用與地緣政治帶來額外風險

除資本支出週期外，美銀還警告，AI應用普及可能導致白領服務業出現大規模職位流失。該行預計，這項風險不會在2027年成為現實，但可能在2028年及以後逐漸成為焦點。
美銀認為，在這種情境下，鑑於聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）的立場偏向寬鬆，聯準會仍將選擇降息。不過，由於技術取代造成的失業屬於結構性失業，而非週期性失業，降息的經濟政策依據並不那麼明確。
日益頻繁的網路攻擊則可能迫使企業放慢AI應用速度，在緩解大規模裁員風險的同時，衝擊AI企業營收，導致資本支出放緩，並對股票和信用市場造成壓力。
伊朗衝突同樣構成雙向風險。美銀指出，過去一年美國居民實質可支配所得僅成長1%，如果能源價格衝擊進一步加劇，實質消費將難以維持目前超過2%的成長速度。相反地，如果衝突獲得解決、能源價格迅速下降，加上股市可能上漲帶來的財富效應，美國國內需求可能顯著增強。

財政赤字與美債殖利率或陷入惡性循環

美銀指出，美國財政問題仍未獲得解決。在基準情境下，該行預計，美國聯邦政府2027財年和2028財年的財政赤字將分別達到2.075兆美元和2.25兆美元，占GDP的比重分別為6.1%和6.4%。
不過，明年美國甚至可能出台更多財政刺激措施。川普政府希望增加國防支出，而民主黨可能同意這項安排，以換取撤回《大而美法案》中的部分醫療補助計畫削減措施。這類政策雖然有利於經濟成長，卻可能使財政赤字在基準預測的基礎上進一步擴大。美銀認為，債券市場最終可能決定美國政府能否實施更多財政刺激，以及刺激措施的規模。
該行警告，即使沒有新增財政刺激，美國債券市場也可能因投資人對財政永續性的擔憂而遭遇拋售。目前，美國聯邦政府淨利息支出占GDP的比重已處於歷史高點，而華府仍缺乏推動財政整頓的意願。
美銀認為，在長期美債殖利率已重新升至5%以上的背景下，美國可能陷入殖利率上升、利息支出增加、財政赤字擴大、殖利率進一步上升的惡性循環，最終對風險性資產價格和經濟活動造成衝擊。
儘管面臨上述風險，美銀目前仍認為美國經濟處於良好狀態。但未來兩年經濟能否延續穩健成長，以及聯準會能否在控制通膨的同時避免經濟衰退，在很大程度上將取決於AI投資浪潮的演變。

items.title: 傳五角大廈曾想動用《國防生產法》讓黃仁勳復職 官方否認
paras: 《華盛頓郵報》週三 (25 日) 報導，美國國防部長海格塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 與五角大廈高層，曾在上週末討論援引《國防生產法》(Defense Production Act)，作為施壓輝達 (NVDA-US) 董事會、促使黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 回任執行長的手段。不過，五角大廈高階官員否認曾有相關討論或提案。
這些討論發生在黃仁勳週一 (23 日) 復職之前。
三名知情人士表示，海格塞斯與副部長費恩伯格 (Steve Feinberg) 等官員，曾研議如何以這項法律作為談判籌碼，推動董事會恢復黃仁勳職務。
他們認為，輝達對美國國家安全至關重要。消息人士因涉及敏感對話，要求匿名。
《國防生產法》於 1950 年制定，賦予美國總統廣泛的經濟干預權力，過去主要用於戰爭或國家緊急狀態期間，動員民間企業提供軍事及其他必要物資。
川普第一任政府也曾在新冠疫情期間援引這項法律，要求通用汽車生產呼吸器。
報導所描述的施壓方式，是透過調整生產優先順序，影響輝達的營運安排。
一名川普政府官員向《華郵》表示：「基本上，他們可以利用《國防生產法》，迫使輝達將更多生產轉向軍事項目。」這可能干擾公司的生產計畫，並衝擊獲利。
至於相關討論是否曾傳達給總統川普或副總統范斯 (JD Vance)，目前仍不清楚，也無法確認五角大廈最終向輝達提出了哪些要求。
另有兩名知情人士告訴《華郵》，川普與范斯逐漸認定，輝達對美國經濟具有重要影響，而黃仁勳具備穩定金融市場的獨特能力。
隨著黃仁勳相關風波拖累股市，川普親自要求范斯介入，協調他重返輝達。
然而，對於上述傳聞，一名不具名的五角大廈高階官員向《華郵》否認：「報導所描述的高層對話從未發生，部長、副部長或次長也未提出任何這類方案。」
黃仁勳已於週一恢復輝達執行長職務。目前報導涉及的是官員是否曾研議以《國防生產法》施壓，並無資訊顯示美國政府已實際援引這項法律，促成此次人事決定。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 上週五重挫 14.01%，週一因黃仁勳復職狂飆 31.48%，隨後兩日累跌 9.54%，週三收 149.30 美元，回吐週一約四成漲幅，仍較復職前高出 18.94%。

items.title: AI記憶體紅利推高經濟成長！南韓央行宣布升息1碼抗通膨 與美利差降至0.75個百分點
items.title_en: AI Memory Bonus Fuels Economic Growth! South Korea Central Bank Raises Interest Rate by 1 Basis Point to Combat Inflation, US-Korea Spread Drops to 0.75 Percentage Point
paras: 南韓央行(BOK)週四(26日)宣布將7天期回購利率上調25個基點至3.25%，結束10月暫停節奏、恢復升息。今年7、8月連升兩次後累計緊縮幅度達75個基點，這是BOK今年下半年第三次升息，與美國的利率差距縮至0.75個百分點。
BOK同步上修經濟成長預期，今年GDP成長率估值從3.3%調高至3.9%，2027年從2.9%上調至4.1%；10月消費者物價指數(CPI)仍達2.8%，核心通膨2.8%，均高於2%目標，房價也還在漲。
驅動力來自「出口端超強、消費端偏弱」的撕裂基本面。全球AI基礎建設投資帶動HBM與企業級NAND超級週期，南韓半導體出口放量，推升經濟成長遠超預期。
BOK決策官員釋放清晰信號：在半導體榮景抵銷家庭需求疲軟、韓股綜合股指(KOSPI)波動的當下，通膨壓力與出口驅動擴張優先級壓過內需擔憂。
不過，市場並非全無顧慮。美銀指出，經常帳順差撐住韓元，但外資持續拋售韓股、綜合指數難守5000點上方；高盛則警告超額利潤集中在三星、海力士兩家，未有效外溢到居民部門，消費僅溫和復甦。
BOK總裁申鉉松隨後記者會成焦點，市場將觀察「終端利率是否衝3.5%」與2027年經濟成長預期會否再上修。若明年GDP成長率估值破3.5%，代表央行對半導體週期更樂觀、緊縮尾巴更長；若措辭轉鴿，則暗示內需與科技股財富效應萎縮已進入決策權衡。
paras_en: The Bank of Korea (BOK) announced on Thursday (26th) that it would raise the 7‑day repo rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, ending the pause in October and resuming rate hikes. After two consecutive increases in July and August, the cumulative tightening has reached 75 basis points, marking the third rate hike for BOK in the second half of the year, and narrowing the gap with U.S. rates to 0.75 percentage point.

BOK also lifted its economic growth outlook, raising the estimated GDP growth rate for this year from 3.3% to 3.9% and for 2027 from 2.9% to 4.1%. The October consumer price index (CPI) remains at 2.8%, core inflation at 2.8%, both above the 2% target, and housing prices continue to rise.

The driving force comes from a split fundamental: a strong export side versus a weaker consumption side. Global AI infrastructure investment is driving a super‑cycle for HBM and enterprise‑grade NAND, boosting South Korean semiconductor exports and pushing economic growth far beyond expectations.

BOK decision makers sent a clear signal: amid the semiconductor boom offsetting weak household demand and volatility in the KOSPI, inflationary pressure and export‑driven expansion take priority over concerns about domestic demand.

However, the market is not without concerns. Bank of America noted that the current account surplus supports the won, but foreign investors continue to sell Korean stocks, making it difficult for the KOSPI to stay above 5,000 points. Goldman Sachs warned that excess profits are concentrated in Samsung and SK Hynix, not effectively spilling over to the consumer sector, and consumption is only mildly recovering.

BOK Governor Seon Hyeon‑song became the focus of a subsequent press conference, with the market watching whether the “terminal rate will hit 3.5%” and whether the 2027 growth outlook will be revised upward. If next year’s GDP growth estimate exceeds 3.5%, it would indicate the central bank is more optimistic about the semiconductor cycle and will keep tightening longer; a dovish tone would suggest that the contraction of domestic demand and the wealth effect of tech stocks have entered decision‑making considerations.

items.title: 黃仁勳「失業11天」在幹嘛？曾私訊好友想騎重機橫越美國
items.title_en: Jensen Huang "Unemployed for 11 Days"—What Was He Doing? He Texted a Friend About Riding a Motorcycle Across the U.S.
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 短暫離開執行長職位期間，曾想騎重機橫越美國。美國知名 Podcast 主持人弗里德曼 (Lex Fridman) 透露，黃仁勳上週主動傳訊息，表示想加入他正在進行的公路旅行。如今黃仁勳重返輝達，讓他忍不住感嘆：「真後悔當時沒有答應，現在他又要忙起來了。」
弗里德曼在社群平台 X 發文表示，自己正在騎機車橫越美國，黃仁勳得知後提出加入，兩人可以各騎一輛機車同行。
他坦言，這番話聽起來或許像在開玩笑，但黃仁勳「很可能是認真的」。
不過，這趟結伴旅行還沒成行，黃仁勳便於 23 日恢復輝達總裁、執行長及董事職務，距離請辭僅過 11 天。
弗里德曼未透露兩人是否討論過出發日期或路線，貼文中則流露出錯過邀約的惋惜。
兩人的往來也不只限於節目訪談。
弗里德曼先前曾表示，自己認識黃仁勳已久，兩人還曾在台灣一起逛夜市、品嘗小吃，談論黃仁勳的童年回憶與科技產業。
除了分享重機邀約，弗里德曼也在貼文中聲援黃仁勳，認為世界需要更多像他這樣的領導者。
他直言，許多領袖表現不佳，值得肯定的人應受到保護，並援引馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 的觀點，主張在人陷入低潮時伸出援手，而非落井下石。
弗里德曼表示，每個人都有缺點，也難免犯錯，但人性中的善意比惡意更多，社會應多支持值得肯定的人與事。
談到美中科技競爭，弗里德曼認為，中國應是美國的競爭對手，而非敵人，因為「戰爭帶來破壞，競爭帶來創造」。
他強調，身為美國人，自己希望美國勝出，但應透過良性競爭，而非軍事衝突與局勢升級。
他也提醒外界，應警惕軍工複合體透過煽動仇恨、恐懼與分裂，推升對抗情緒，並將黃仁勳形容為「和平締造者」，認為他對美國在科技競爭中取得成功至關重要。
發文當下，弗里德曼仍在旅途中。
他說，自己正坐在偏遠地區的一處加油站，喝完咖啡、稍作休息後，準備繼續騎車上路，並感嘆騎機車帶來的自由感無可比擬。至於曾想加入的黃仁勳，則已回到輝達，重新投入公司事務。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 上週五重挫 14.01%，週一因黃仁勳復職狂飆 31.48%，隨後兩日累跌 9.54%，週三收 149.30 美元，回吐週一約四成漲幅，仍較復職前高出 18.94%。
paras_en: During a brief period when NVIDIA (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang stepped away from the CEO role, he considered riding a motorcycle across the United States. U.S. podcast host Lex Fridman revealed that last week Huang proactively sent a message expressing his desire to join Fridman's ongoing road trip. Now that Huang has returned to NVIDIA, he cannot help but lament, "I really regret not agreeing back then; now he's busy again."
Fridman posted on X that he was riding a motorcycle across the U.S., and upon learning this, Huang suggested joining him, with the two of them riding separate bikes together.
He admitted that the suggestion might sound like a joke, but Huang "probably was serious."
However, the joint trip never materialized, and on the 23rd Huang resumed his positions as NVIDIA president, CEO, and board member, just 11 days after announcing his resignation.
Fridman did not disclose whether the two discussed a departure date or route; the post expressed regret at missing the invitation.
Their interactions extend beyond interview appearances.

Fridman previously noted that he has known Huang for a long time, and the two once visited night markets and sampled street food in Taiwan, discussing Huang's childhood memories and the tech industry.
In addition to sharing the motorcycle invitation, Fridman also voiced support for Huang, stating that the world needs more leaders like him.

He bluntly said that many leaders perform poorly, and those who deserve recognition should be protected, citing Elon Musk's view that one should lend a hand when people are in a slump rather than throw stones into a pit.
Fridman said everyone has flaws and can make mistakes, but the good in humanity outweighs the bad; society should support those who deserve praise and positive actions.
When discussing U.S.-China tech competition, Fridman believes China should be a competitor, not an enemy, because "war brings destruction, competition brings creation."
He emphasized that as an American, he hopes the U.S. wins, but through healthy competition rather than military conflict or escalation.

He also warned the public to be wary of the military-industrial complex inflaming hatred, fear, and division to heighten antagonism, and described Huang as a "peacemaker," believing he is crucial to U.S. success in tech competition.
At the time of posting, Fridman was still on the road.

He said he was sitting at a remote gas station, finished a cup of coffee, took a short break, and was ready to continue riding, marveling at the incomparable freedom of motorcycling; as for Huang, he had returned to NVIDIA and refocused on company matters.

NVIDIA (NVDA-US) fell 14.01% last Friday, surged 31.48% on Monday after Huang's return, then dropped 9.54% over the next two days, closing at $149.30 on Wednesday, retracting about 40% of Monday's gains but remaining 18.94% above the pre‑resignation level.

items.title: 川普12/4赴亞利桑那州 出席台積電晶片廠擴建動土典禮
items.title_en: Trump to Attend TSMC Arizona Plant Groundbreaking on Dec. 4
paras: 《美聯社》報導，白宮與台灣半導體製造商台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)表示，將經濟政策寄望於AI產業成長的美國總統川普，將於12月4日前往亞利桑那州，出席台積電新晶圓廠的動土典禮。
此次行程正值華府本週密切檢視AI產業之際。此前，川普介入輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)執行長人事，協助黃仁勳重新掌舵。黃仁勳預定12月3日出席參議院銀行委員會聽證會，屆時將面臨議員質詢，內容包括輝達如何向海外銷售晶片，以及他與一名涉嫌中國間諜的女性發生婚外情一事。
台積電近年積極擴大在亞利桑那州鳳凰城一帶的布局，並利用美國廠區為輝達、蘋果(AAPL-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)及高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)等科技公司生產晶片。川普此次將出席台積電亞利桑那州擴建計畫第五期工程的動土典禮。
台積電今年7月宣布，將再投入1,000億美元擴大美國製造產能，使其在美國晶片製造領域承諾的總投資額達到2,650億美元。
隨著人工智慧發展帶動電腦晶片需求增加，加上台灣在晶片製造領域的主導地位，促使包括美國在內的各國正透過提高國內產能，因應供應鏈脆弱性的問題，台積電的投資規模也隨之擴大。
川普一直試圖將這些投資歸功於他的關稅政策，但台積電早在前總統拜登任內，就已開始在亞利桑那州興建廠房。拜登簽署生效的跨黨派「晶片與科學法案」(CHIPS and Science Act)，也為這項計畫提供部分財務支持。
白宮表示，這次擴建計畫預計將創造1萬個直接就業機會，以及在周邊社區新增1.1萬個間接就業機會。目前該廠區已提供超過1.2萬個營建工作機會。
paras_en: The Associated Press reports that the White House and Taiwan semiconductor manufacturer TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) say that U.S. President Donald Trump, who has placed economic policy hopes on the growth of the AI industry, will travel to Arizona on December 4 to attend the groundbreaking ceremony for TSMC’s new wafer plant.

This trip comes as Washington closely examines the AI sector this week. Earlier, Trump intervened in Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO personnel, helping Jensen Huang regain control. Huang is scheduled to appear before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3, where he will face questions from senators about Nvidia’s overseas chip sales and a rumored affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.

TSMC has been actively expanding its footprint around Phoenix, Arizona, and uses its U.S. facilities to produce chips for Nvidia, Apple (AAPL‑US), AMD (AMD‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US). Trump will attend the groundbreaking for Phase 5 of TSMC’s Arizona expansion plan.
In July, TSMC announced it would invest an additional $100 billion to expand U.S. manufacturing capacity, bringing its total U.S. investment pledge to $265 billion.

With AI development driving increased demand for computer chips and Taiwan’s dominance in chip manufacturing, countries including the United States are boosting domestic capacity to address supply‑chain fragility, leading to larger TSMC investment scales.

Trump has long tried to attribute these investments to his tariff policy, but TSMC began building its Arizona plant during former President Biden’s term. Biden signed the bipartisan CHIPS and Science Act, which also provided partial financial support for the project.
The White House says the expansion is expected to create 10,000 direct jobs and add 11,000 indirect jobs in surrounding communities. The site already offers more than 12,000 construction jobs.

items.title: AI信仰遭遇極限壓力測試！美股超級「V轉」 分析師：深V不是轉折  是分歧
items.title_en: AI Faith Faces Extreme Pressure Test! US Stocks Super “V-Shape” Analysts: Deep V Is Not a Turning Point but a Divergence
paras: 華爾街週三(25日)上演一場「驚魂深V」劇本，盤中恐慌式殺盤，尾盤硬拉收回，但市場情緒的底層邏輯已經換了。
那斯達克100指數(NDX) 開盤5分鐘便重挫近5%，那斯達克指數一度跌約4.5%，標普500盤中跌超3%、道瓊指數(DJI) 一度狂瀉逾1100點，費城半導體(SOX)跌近8%，輝達(NVDA-US) 盤中一度跌近9%，隨後跌幅全數收斂，道瓊翻紅收漲0.33%，標普僅跌0.25%，那指收跌0.62%。
金銀同步演「超級V」，現貨金價盤中最低見到每盎司3426美元，尾盤拉回漲0.92%收3588.41美元，白銀盤中跌超6%，收漲1.15%至41.38美元。
兩天前白宮推動黃仁勳復任輝達執行長，曾讓AI鏈單日暴漲、那指漲超6%，但這波「情緒紓困」沒撐過一日遊。
Running Oak Capital執行長Seth Cogswell直言：「這試圖成為一次AI行業紓困，但沒奏效，人們看穿了。」
更麻煩的是治理溢價被撕開。標普全球評級週三將輝達AA評級列入「負面觀察」，指黃仁勳離任又復職暴露董事會獨立性、接班計畫與監督機制漏洞，90天內可能降至AA-，輝達週三收跌3.91%，CDS違約保護成本創新高。
真正壓抑風險偏好的，是敘事切換。Solstein Capital執行長Terman說：「市場不再爭論AI會不會改變世界，而在問誰能賺錢、能賺多少、數兆美元資本開支能不能回收。諷刺的是，技術承諾兌現了，財務回報卻可能讓投資人失望。」
聯準會(Fed)重啟緊縮讓這道題更尖銳：融資成本抬升，資料中心、HBM、算力租賃的ROI必須更高才合理。期中選舉後民主黨對資料中心擴張的阻力、出口管制不確定性，再疊一層政策折現風險。
NYSE交易廳老將Jonathan Corpina把當前市場情緒跟2008年時類比說道：「不是拋售規模一樣，是那種『接下來還會怎樣』的持續不安。」
TradeMas交易員Peter Tuchman則說：「從未見過同一個故事——英偉達——讓市場看法反轉得這麼徹底。」
分析師指出，拋售「有序」，獲利與宏觀底子還在，但盤面已變成情緒博弈。
Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek苦笑說：「過去10天搖頭次數太多，脖子都酸了。」他客戶最怕的不是繼續跌，而是「萬一反彈踏空」。
深V不是轉折，是分歧。AI技術前景不再是最大爭議，「數兆美元投入能否變成足夠獲利、市場還願不願續費」才是定價核心。短期看Fed態度與輝達治理修補，中期看雲廠資本開支回報，這一輪洗盤後，留下的只會是最有信念、也最會算帳的資金。
paras_en: Wall Street staged a “deep V” drama on Wednesday (25th), with panic selling in the middle of the day and a hard pullback at the close, but the underlying market logic had already shifted.

The Nasdaq 100 (NDX) fell nearly 5% in the first five minutes of trading, the Nasdaq index briefly dropped about 4.5%, the S&P 500 fell over 3% mid‑day, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJI) plunged more than 1,100 points, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) fell nearly 8%, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped almost 9% mid‑day before the declines converged; the Dow ended up 0.33% higher, the S&P only down 0.25%, and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.

Gold and silver both performed a “super V,” with spot gold hitting a low of $3,426 per ounce mid‑day and rebounding 0.92% to close at $3,588.41, while silver fell over 6% mid‑day and closed up 1.15% at $41.38.

Two days ago the White House pushed for Jensen Huang’s reappointment as Nvidia CEO, which once caused a one‑day surge in AI stocks and a 6% rise in the Nasdaq, but this “emotional relief” did not last beyond the day.
Running Oak Capital CEO Seth Cogswell bluntly said, “This was an attempt to provide a bailout for the AI industry, but it failed; people see through it.”

Complicating matters further, governance premiums were ripped apart. S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia’s AA rating under “negative watch” on Wednesday, citing that Huang’s departure and return exposed board independence, succession planning, and oversight mechanism weaknesses, with a possible downgrade to AA‑ within 90 days. Nvidia fell 3.91% on Wednesday and CDS default protection costs hit a new high.

The real risk‑aversion comes from a narrative shift. Solstein Capital CEO Terman said, “The market no longer debates whether AI will change the world; it asks who can make money, how much, and whether the trillions of dollars in capital spend can be recouped. Ironically, the technology promise has been fulfilled, but financial returns may disappoint investors.”

The Fed’s re‑tightening makes this issue sharper: financing costs rise, and the ROI for data centers, HBM, and compute‑as‑a‑service must be higher to be justified. After the midterm election, Democratic resistance to data‑center expansion, export‑control uncertainty, and additional policy discount risk stack on.
NYSE veteran Jonathan Corpina compared the current market sentiment to 2008, saying, “It’s not the same scale of selling, but the persistent unease about ‘what will happen next’.”
TradeMas trader Peter Tuchman said, “I’ve never seen the same story—Nvidia—flip market sentiment so thoroughly.”
Analysts noted that the sell‑off is “ordered,” profits and macro fundamentals remain, but the market has become an emotional game.

Siebert Financial CIO Mark Malek grimaced, “We’ve been shaking our heads too many times in the past 10 days; our necks are sore.” He said his clients fear not a continued decline but a missed rebound if they sell too early.

The deep V is not a turning point but a divergence. The future of AI technology is no longer the biggest debate; the question is whether trillions of dollars of investment can generate sufficient profit and whether the market will continue to pay for it. In the short term, Fed stance and Nvidia governance fixes matter; in the midterm, cloud‑provider capital‑spend returns will determine the outcome. After this round of market cleaning, only the most committed and financially savvy investors will remain.

items.title: 星巴克、瑞幸扎堆入局 飲品開始在中國拚高蛋白了
items.title_en: Starbucks, Luckin Crowd into the Market as Drinks in China Compete for High Protein
paras: 今年以來，高蛋白飲品站上風口。
今年4月，星巴克(SBUX-US) 中國宣布在全國門市推出高蛋白拿鐵PRO系列，高蛋白被單獨做成新的菜單入口。隨後又推出高蛋白馥芮白PRO、太妃榛果高蛋白拿鐵等多款飲品。
星巴克中國首席增長官楊振表示，這是繼去年「真味無糖」創新平台後，針對消費者日益增長的健康需求的又一布局。
星巴克並非孤例。皮爺咖啡、COSTA咖世家、拉瓦薩（Lavazza）咖啡、瑞幸等先後推出高蛋白飲品。
另一邊，肯德基子品牌KPRO推出肯律輕食，伊利推出透明蛋白水，盒馬擺出蛋白質水。
《21世紀經濟報導》26日指出，同樣是高蛋白，品牌賣的不是同一種生意。
星巴克、皮爺、拉瓦薩和COSTA的布局，更像是一場奶咖溢價保衛戰。
過去幾年，現製咖啡價格一路下探，團購券、外賣補貼和人民幣9.9元促銷不斷擠壓一杯奶咖的定價空間。高蛋白奶、0乳糖、原生乳蛋白，給了中高端咖啡一個新的溢價解釋。
消費者支付的不是更貴的牛奶，而是一份可以兼顧提神和營養補給的早餐。
瑞幸、KPRO和奈雪爭奪的則是「飲品之外的一餐」。
KPRO原本就擁有輕食、健身和控卡客群，高蛋白酸奶昔可以自然嵌入套餐；奈雪在海外店把蛋白與牛油果、莓果、益生菌組合，試圖讓一杯茶飲具備更強代餐屬性。
這些飲食真正的對手，不只是同行新品，還有便利商店沙拉、優格、蛋白棒和簡餐。
第三類玩家不在門市，而在貨架和供應鏈上。
蒙牛M-PLUS每日蛋白牛乳每瓶250毫升含15克原生乳蛋白；一個月後，M-PLUS又上架15克蛋白低溫益生菌酸奶。
伊利則把乳清蛋白做成了「透明蛋白水」。Puritime每瓶300毫升含9克分離乳清蛋白。京東七鮮與ffit8又聯合推出330毫升膠原蛋白肽水，每瓶添加不少於6克膠原蛋白肽。盒馬的蛋白質水則以500毫升、12.5克分離乳清蛋白切入貨架。
這構成了一個清晰高蛋白飲品賽道。乳企和零售商先把蛋白原料、口感和價格帶跑出來。連鎖飲品店再把它翻譯成早餐、午餐、下午茶和運動補給。
同時，茶飲、乳業品牌對高蛋白賽道的未來格外看好。蒙牛董事會副主席、執行董事兼總裁高飛曾表示，希望蒙牛M-PLUS每日蛋白牛乳這一產品成為「特侖蘇之後的又一個大單品」。
茶百道在2024年ESG報告中已將高蛋白列為低糖、低熱量之外的健康化定製方向；蜜雪冰城與悅鮮活則宣布圍繞高蛋白聯合研發。
paras_en: This year, high‑protein drinks have taken the spotlight.

In April, Starbucks (SBUX‑US) China announced the nationwide launch of the high‑protein latte PRO series, creating a new menu entry for high protein. It was followed by the high‑protein Frappuccino PRO, caramel hazelnut high‑protein latte, and several other drinks.
Starbucks China’s chief growth officer, Yang Zhen, said this is another move to meet consumers’ growing health demands, following last year’s “True Taste Unsweetened” innovation platform.
Starbucks is not alone. Papa Coffee, COSTA, Lavazza, and Luckin have all introduced high‑protein drinks.
Meanwhile, KFC’s sub‑brand KPRO launched K‑Lyu light meals, Yili released transparent protein water, and Hema offered protein water.
The 21st Century Economic Report on the 26th noted that, although all are high‑protein, the brands are selling different kinds of business.
Starbucks, Papa, Lavazza, and COSTA’s strategy resembles a premium defense of milk‑based coffee.

In recent years, the price of freshly brewed coffee has fallen, with group‑purchase coupons, delivery subsidies, and 9.9‑yuan promotions squeezing the pricing space for a cup of milk coffee. High‑protein milk, lactose‑free, and native milk protein provide a new premium justification for mid‑to‑high‑end coffee.
Consumers are paying not for more expensive milk, but for a breakfast that can both wake them up and provide nutritional support.
Luckin, KPRO, and Naixue are competing for a “meal outside of drinks.”

KPRO already has a light‑food, fitness, and calorie‑control customer base, so high‑protein yogurt smoothies can naturally fit into a meal set; Naixue combines protein with avocado, berries, and probiotics in overseas stores, aiming to give a tea drink stronger meal‑replacement attributes.
These real competitors are not just new products from peers, but also convenience‑store salads, yogurts, protein bars, and quick meals.
The third group of players is not in stores, but on shelves and supply chains.
Mengniu’s M‑PLUS Daily Protein Milk, 250‑ml bottles contain 15 g of native milk protein; a month later, M‑PLUS launched a 15‑g protein low‑temperature probiotic yogurt.

Yili turned whey protein into “transparent protein water.” Puritime’s 300‑ml bottle contains 9 g of isolated whey protein. JD’s Qishen and ffit8 jointly launched a 330‑ml collagen peptide water, adding at least 6 g of collagen peptides per bottle. Hema’s protein water entered the shelf with 500‑ml bottles containing 12.5 g of isolated whey protein.

This creates a clear high‑protein beverage track. Dairy companies and retailers first bring protein raw materials, taste, and price to market. Chain beverage stores then translate them into breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and sports nutrition.

At the same time, tea and dairy brands are very optimistic about the future of the high‑protein track. Mengniu’s board deputy chairman, executive director, and president Gao Fei said he hopes Mengniu M‑PLUS Daily Protein Milk will become “another big single product after Telenor.”
Tea Baidao listed high protein as a health‑customization direction beyond low sugar and low calorie in its 2024 ESG report; Mixue Bingcheng and Yuexianhu announced joint R&D around high protein.

items.title: AI記憶體紅利推高經濟成長！南韓央行宣布升息1碼抗通膨 與美利差降至0.75個百分點
items.title_en: AI Memory Bonus Fuels Economic Growth! South Korea Central Bank Raises Interest Rate by 1 Basis Point to Combat Inflation, US-Korea Spread Drops to 0.75 Percentage Point
paras: 南韓央行(BOK)週四(26日)宣布將7天期回購利率上調25個基點至3.25%，結束10月暫停節奏、恢復升息。今年7、8月連升兩次後累計緊縮幅度達75個基點，這是BOK今年下半年第三次升息，與美國的利率差距縮至0.75個百分點。
BOK同步上修經濟成長預期，今年GDP成長率估值從3.3%調高至3.9%，2027年從2.9%上調至4.1%；10月消費者物價指數(CPI)仍達2.8%，核心通膨2.8%，均高於2%目標，房價也還在漲。
驅動力來自「出口端超強、消費端偏弱」的撕裂基本面。全球AI基礎建設投資帶動HBM與企業級NAND超級週期，南韓半導體出口放量，推升經濟成長遠超預期。
BOK決策官員釋放清晰信號：在半導體榮景抵銷家庭需求疲軟、韓股綜合股指(KOSPI)波動的當下，通膨壓力與出口驅動擴張優先級壓過內需擔憂。
不過，市場並非全無顧慮。美銀指出，經常帳順差撐住韓元，但外資持續拋售韓股、綜合指數難守5000點上方；高盛則警告超額利潤集中在三星、海力士兩家，未有效外溢到居民部門，消費僅溫和復甦。
BOK總裁申鉉松隨後記者會成焦點，市場將觀察「終端利率是否衝3.5%」與2027年經濟成長預期會否再上修。若明年GDP成長率估值破3.5%，代表央行對半導體週期更樂觀、緊縮尾巴更長；若措辭轉鴿，則暗示內需與科技股財富效應萎縮已進入決策權衡。
paras_en: The Bank of Korea (BOK) announced on Thursday (26th) that it would raise the 7‑day repo rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, ending the pause in October and resuming rate hikes. After two consecutive increases in July and August, the cumulative tightening has reached 75 basis points, marking the third rate hike for BOK in the second half of the year, and narrowing the gap with U.S. rates to 0.75 percentage point.

BOK also lifted its economic growth outlook, raising the estimated GDP growth rate for this year from 3.3% to 3.9% and for 2027 from 2.9% to 4.1%. The October consumer price index (CPI) remains at 2.8%, core inflation at 2.8%, both above the 2% target, and housing prices continue to rise.

The driving force comes from a split fundamental: a strong export side versus a weaker consumption side. Global AI infrastructure investment is driving a super‑cycle for HBM and enterprise‑grade NAND, boosting South Korean semiconductor exports and pushing economic growth far beyond expectations.

BOK decision makers sent a clear signal: amid the semiconductor boom offsetting weak household demand and volatility in the KOSPI, inflationary pressure and export‑driven expansion take priority over concerns about domestic demand.

However, the market is not without concerns. Bank of America noted that the current account surplus supports the won, but foreign investors continue to sell Korean stocks, making it difficult for the KOSPI to stay above 5,000 points. Goldman Sachs warned that excess profits are concentrated in Samsung and SK Hynix, not effectively spilling over to the consumer sector, and consumption is only mildly recovering.

BOK Governor Seon Hyeon‑song became the focus of a subsequent press conference, with the market watching whether the “terminal rate will hit 3.5%” and whether the 2027 growth outlook will be revised upward. If next year’s GDP growth estimate exceeds 3.5%, it would indicate the central bank is more optimistic about the semiconductor cycle and will keep tightening longer; a dovish tone would suggest that the contraction of domestic demand and the wealth effect of tech stocks have entered decision‑making considerations.

items.title: AI信仰遭遇極限壓力測試！美股超級「V轉」 分析師：深V不是轉折  是分歧
items.title_en: AI Faith Faces Extreme Pressure Test! US Stocks Super “V-Shape” Analysts: Deep V Is Not a Turning Point but a Divergence
paras: 華爾街週三(25日)上演一場「驚魂深V」劇本，盤中恐慌式殺盤，尾盤硬拉收回，但市場情緒的底層邏輯已經換了。
那斯達克100指數(NDX) 開盤5分鐘便重挫近5%，那斯達克指數一度跌約4.5%，標普500盤中跌超3%、道瓊指數(DJI) 一度狂瀉逾1100點，費城半導體(SOX)跌近8%，輝達(NVDA-US) 盤中一度跌近9%，隨後跌幅全數收斂，道瓊翻紅收漲0.33%，標普僅跌0.25%，那指收跌0.62%。
金銀同步演「超級V」，現貨金價盤中最低見到每盎司3426美元，尾盤拉回漲0.92%收3588.41美元，白銀盤中跌超6%，收漲1.15%至41.38美元。
兩天前白宮推動黃仁勳復任輝達執行長，曾讓AI鏈單日暴漲、那指漲超6%，但這波「情緒紓困」沒撐過一日遊。
Running Oak Capital執行長Seth Cogswell直言：「這試圖成為一次AI行業紓困，但沒奏效，人們看穿了。」
更麻煩的是治理溢價被撕開。標普全球評級週三將輝達AA評級列入「負面觀察」，指黃仁勳離任又復職暴露董事會獨立性、接班計畫與監督機制漏洞，90天內可能降至AA-，輝達週三收跌3.91%，CDS違約保護成本創新高。
真正壓抑風險偏好的，是敘事切換。Solstein Capital執行長Terman說：「市場不再爭論AI會不會改變世界，而在問誰能賺錢、能賺多少、數兆美元資本開支能不能回收。諷刺的是，技術承諾兌現了，財務回報卻可能讓投資人失望。」
聯準會(Fed)重啟緊縮讓這道題更尖銳：融資成本抬升，資料中心、HBM、算力租賃的ROI必須更高才合理。期中選舉後民主黨對資料中心擴張的阻力、出口管制不確定性，再疊一層政策折現風險。
NYSE交易廳老將Jonathan Corpina把當前市場情緒跟2008年時類比說道：「不是拋售規模一樣，是那種『接下來還會怎樣』的持續不安。」
TradeMas交易員Peter Tuchman則說：「從未見過同一個故事——英偉達——讓市場看法反轉得這麼徹底。」
分析師指出，拋售「有序」，獲利與宏觀底子還在，但盤面已變成情緒博弈。
Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek苦笑說：「過去10天搖頭次數太多，脖子都酸了。」他客戶最怕的不是繼續跌，而是「萬一反彈踏空」。
深V不是轉折，是分歧。AI技術前景不再是最大爭議，「數兆美元投入能否變成足夠獲利、市場還願不願續費」才是定價核心。短期看Fed態度與輝達治理修補，中期看雲廠資本開支回報，這一輪洗盤後，留下的只會是最有信念、也最會算帳的資金。
paras_en: Wall Street staged a “deep V” drama on Wednesday (25th), with panic selling in the middle of the day and a hard pullback at the close, but the underlying market logic had already shifted.

The Nasdaq 100 (NDX) fell nearly 5% in the first five minutes of trading, the Nasdaq index briefly dropped about 4.5%, the S&P 500 fell over 3% mid‑day, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJI) plunged more than 1,100 points, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) fell nearly 8%, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dropped almost 9% mid‑day before the declines converged; the Dow ended up 0.33% higher, the S&P only down 0.25%, and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.

Gold and silver both performed a “super V,” with spot gold hitting a low of $3,426 per ounce mid‑day and rebounding 0.92% to close at $3,588.41, while silver fell over 6% mid‑day and closed up 1.15% at $41.38.

Two days ago the White House pushed for Jensen Huang’s reappointment as Nvidia CEO, which once caused a one‑day surge in AI stocks and a 6% rise in the Nasdaq, but this “emotional relief” did not last beyond the day.
Running Oak Capital CEO Seth Cogswell bluntly said, “This was an attempt to provide a bailout for the AI industry, but it failed; people see through it.”

Complicating matters further, governance premiums were ripped apart. S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia’s AA rating under “negative watch” on Wednesday, citing that Huang’s departure and return exposed board independence, succession planning, and oversight mechanism weaknesses, with a possible downgrade to AA‑ within 90 days. Nvidia fell 3.91% on Wednesday and CDS default protection costs hit a new high.

The real risk‑aversion comes from a narrative shift. Solstein Capital CEO Terman said, “The market no longer debates whether AI will change the world; it asks who can make money, how much, and whether the trillions of dollars in capital spend can be recouped. Ironically, the technology promise has been fulfilled, but financial returns may disappoint investors.”

The Fed’s re‑tightening makes this issue sharper: financing costs rise, and the ROI for data centers, HBM, and compute‑as‑a‑service must be higher to be justified. After the midterm election, Democratic resistance to data‑center expansion, export‑control uncertainty, and additional policy discount risk stack on.
NYSE veteran Jonathan Corpina compared the current market sentiment to 2008, saying, “It’s not the same scale of selling, but the persistent unease about ‘what will happen next’.”
TradeMas trader Peter Tuchman said, “I’ve never seen the same story—Nvidia—flip market sentiment so thoroughly.”
Analysts noted that the sell‑off is “ordered,” profits and macro fundamentals remain, but the market has become an emotional game.

Siebert Financial CIO Mark Malek grimaced, “We’ve been shaking our heads too many times in the past 10 days; our necks are sore.” He said his clients fear not a continued decline but a missed rebound if they sell too early.

The deep V is not a turning point but a divergence. The future of AI technology is no longer the biggest debate; the question is whether trillions of dollars of investment can generate sufficient profit and whether the market will continue to pay for it. In the short term, Fed stance and Nvidia governance fixes matter; in the midterm, cloud‑provider capital‑spend returns will determine the outcome. After this round of market cleaning, only the most committed and financially savvy investors will remain.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 AI股震盪引發市場避險情緒推升日元、瑞郎
paras: 美元週三(25日)走弱，AI相關股票大幅下挫，隨後又收復大部分早盤跌幅，市場經歷劇烈震盪，避險貨幣瑞士法郎與日元走強。
科技股占比較高的那斯達克綜合指數一度因AI概念股再度遭遇賣壓而下跌約4%，隨後反彈，終場跌幅收斂至約0.6%。
美元稍早受惠於市場避險情緒升溫，但在交易時段後段轉為下跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.22%，報103.62。
investingLive首席外匯分析師Adam Button表示，股市出現「大幅反攻」。「我想知道，這是否只是因假期縮短交易週而出現的空頭回補行情，但即使是最糟的情況，這至少也是市場重新展現活力的訊號。」
美國大多數市場週四將因感恩節假期休市。
過去股市下跌時，美元一直扮演避險貨幣的角色，但同時受到與AI投資熱潮相關的資金流入及經濟成長預期影響。
歐元兌美元上漲0.17%，至1.0983美元。
日元兌美元上漲0.06%，至1美元兌159.13日元。
美元兌瑞士法郎下跌0.63%，至0.83瑞郎。
對風險較敏感的澳幣下跌0.15%，至0.6628美元，稍早一度跌至0.6557美元，創12月3日以來最低。
交易員也正評估，聯準會(Fed)在持續面臨高於理想水準的通膨之際，未來可能還會升息幾次。
美國10月通膨進一步升溫，個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數上月上漲0.3%，9月則維持先前公布的0.5%增幅。排除波動較大的食品及能源價格後，核心PCE物價指數上月也上漲0.3%，與9月未經修正的0.3%增幅相同。
然而，隨著近期油價下跌，市場通膨預期近幾週已經回落。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略主管Sarah Ying表示，「更重要的問題在於，你認為最終利率會落在什麼水準？這也是為什麼你會看到5年期債券表現略優於2年期債券，因為大部分相關疑問都集中在較長期，而不一定是可預見的未來。」
美國2年期與5年期公債殖利率曲線已趨於平坦，目前利差約為2個基點，相較之下，上個月利差一度高達27個基點。市場預期聯準會可能進一步升息，對利率敏感的2年期公債殖利率因此承壓。
另一方面，市場對川普政府週三提出、針對14個主要貿易夥伴商品加徵新關稅的計畫反應不大。這些關稅措施旨在因應美方所稱的結構性工業產能過剩，其中中國將面臨最高稅率。華府認為，中國是以低價出口商品充斥全球市場的主要責任方。中國則駁斥這項指控，表示其出口反映的是自身競爭優勢。

Ying表示，市場早已預期這些關稅措施，因此並未對市場造成影響。「這並不是第二次『解放日』。」

items.title: 美股跌勢燒進匯市！套利交易甜頭縮水 華爾街提高警戒
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Slide, Ripple Through Forex! Carry‑Trade Gains Shrink, Wall Street Raises Alerts
paras: 美股AI交易降溫，衝擊正延伸至匯市。過去受惠於利差、經濟韌性與低波動環境的外匯套利交易(carry trade)，如今也面臨考驗。儘管部分策略今年報酬一度接近20%，隨著市場震盪加劇，華爾街認為，輕鬆獲利的階段可能已經過去。
據《彭博》報導，套利交易是指投資人借入日元、歐元或美元等利率相對較低的貨幣，再投入收益較高的市場，賺取利差。不過，一旦投資標的貨幣貶值，匯損就可能迅速侵蝕累積的利息收益。

套利仍有獲利 華爾街提醒不能買了就不管

過去一年多，利差夠大、經濟成長穩健，加上股市走高與長時間低波動，讓套利交易即使遭遇伊朗戰爭、日元干預及土耳其政治醜聞引發的市場動盪，仍能維持表現。
但近期AI交易出現裂痕，削弱風險偏好並推升波動，對仰賴平穩市場的套利策略形成壓力。
Brandywine Global Investment Management投資組合經理Tracy Chen表示：「這筆交易最容易賺錢的階段，可能已經過去了。我不會說套利交易結束了，而是持有這些部位的門檻提高了。」
套利交易整體仍有獲利。《彭博》一項指標顯示，截至周二，以歐元融資的一籃子新興市場部位，今年來報酬仍達13%；以美元融資的策略，過去兩年報酬則約18%。不過，這些報酬已較幾周前縮水，經理人對2027年能否再現亮眼表現，也更為審慎。
高盛(GS-US)認為，經過多年強勁表現後，套利交易大幅獲利的空間已更有限。花旗集團(C-US)美國外匯交易團隊則提醒，不能把套利視為建立部位後就能放著不管的交易。

巴西幣單日重挫8% 年內18%報酬幾乎吐光

巴西就是風險迅速浮現的例子。當地雙位數利率，原本讓巴西成為套利交易熱門目的地，但總統魯拉在決選中擊敗市場偏好的Flavio Bolsonaro後，巴西幣單日重挫8%，創逾20年最大跌幅，促使投資人平倉。
決選前，買進巴西幣、賣出美元的部位，今年來報酬曾達18%；截至周二，累積報酬卻只剩0.5%。
貝萊德(BLK-US)新興市場債券團隊投資組合經理Pablo Goldberg形容，套利交易「獲利像爬樓梯，回吐卻像搭電梯往下」。他提醒，若部位集中於單一貨幣，就必須格外留意風險。
不過，支持套利交易的條件尚未完全消失。即使美股近期下跌，標普500與那斯達克100指數今年仍維持漲勢，有望連續第四年收高。摩根大通(JPM-US)追蹤的外匯波動指標雖然上升，也仍明顯低於3月底的多月高點。

銀行轉向挑選貨幣 搭配日元部位避險

摩根大通策略師預期，套利交易在2027年仍能發揮作用，但表現將更容易受到股市波動，以及市場對Fed最終政策利率預期變化的影響。
因此，該行建議投資人搭配防禦性避險，例如買進日元、賣出紐西蘭元或瑞士法郎，而非單純押注利差收益。
富國銀行(WFC-US)對新興市場套利交易更加挑剔，並避開以G10貨幣進行這類策略。該行仍看好土耳其里拉等高息貨幣，也認為收益較低的印度盧比可能有不錯表現。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)則預期，新興市場套利交易仍有機會維持良好表現，但建議使用歐元等美元以外的貨幣融資。歐元近來也受到希望避開日元波動的交易員青睞。
摩根資產管理新興市場債券主管Pierre-Yves Bareau已降低套利曝險，但仍分散持有哥倫比亞披索、巴西幣及土耳其里拉等部位，規模則小於年初。
他表示，巴西、埃及與奈及利亞等市場的波動，凸顯投資人必須更加注意風險：「你仍會想參與，但必須非常有紀律。」
paras_en: U.S. equity AI trading has cooled, and the impact is now extending to the foreign‑exchange market. The carry trade, which has previously benefited from interest‑rate differentials, economic resilience and a low‑volatility environment, is now facing a test. Although some strategies posted returns near 20% earlier this year, Wall Street believes the easy‑profit phase may be over as market turbulence intensifies.

According to Bloomberg, a carry trade involves investors borrowing low‑yielding currencies such as the yen, euro or dollar and investing the proceeds in higher‑yielding assets to capture the spread. However, if the target currency depreciates, exchange‑rate losses can quickly erode the accrued interest earnings.
Carry trades can still be profitable, but Wall Street warns that they cannot be set‑and‑forgotten.

Over the past year-plus, ample spreads, solid economic growth, rising equity markets and prolonged low volatility allowed carry trades to perform even amid turmoil from the Iran war, yen interventions and Turkey’s political scandal.

Tracy Chen, portfolio manager at Brandywine Global Investment Management, said, “The easiest phase to make money on this trade may have passed. I’m not saying carry trades are finished, but the threshold to hold these positions has risen.”

Carry trades remain profitable overall. Bloomberg data show that, as of Tuesday, a basket of emerging‑market positions funded with euros has returned 13% year‑to‑date, while dollar‑funded strategies have delivered about 18% over the past two years. Those returns have narrowed in recent weeks, and managers are more cautious about whether the strategy can shine again in 2027.

Goldman Sachs (GS-US) believes that after years of strong performance, the upside potential for carry trades has become more limited. Citi’s (C-US) U.S. FX trading team cautions that carry trades should not be treated as a set‑and‑forget position.

The Brazilian real exemplifies how risk can surface quickly. Double‑digit local rates once made Brazil a popular carry‑trade destination, but after President Lula defeated market‑favored Flavio Bolsonaro in the runoff, the real plunged 8% in a single day – the biggest drop in over 20 years – prompting investors to unwind positions.
Before the runoff, a long‑real/short‑dollar position had generated an 18% return year‑to‑date; by Tuesday the cumulative gain had shrunk to just 0.5%.

Pablo Goldberg, portfolio manager of BlackRock’s (BLK-US) emerging‑market bond team, described carry‑trade profits as “climbing stairs, while the unwind feels like an elevator going down.” He warned that concentration in a single currency requires heightened risk vigilance.

Nevertheless, the conditions that support carry trades have not vanished entirely. Even as U.S. equities have recently slipped, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq‑100 have stayed in positive territory this year, potentially delivering a fourth consecutive year of gains. JPMorgan’s (JPM-US) FX volatility index has risen but remains well below the multi‑month highs seen at the end of March.
JPMorgan strategists expect carry trades to still play a role in 2027, though performance will be more sensitive to equity‑market swings and shifts in expectations for the Fed’s final policy rate.
Consequently, the bank advises investors to pair defensive hedges—such as buying yen and selling New Zealand dollars or Swiss francs—rather than simply betting on spread returns.

Wells Fargo (WFC-US) is more selective on emerging‑market carry trades and avoids using G‑10 currencies for such strategies. The bank remains bullish on high‑yielding currencies like the Turkish lira and sees potential in the lower‑yielding Indian rupee.

Morgan Stanley (MS-US) expects emerging‑market carry trades to continue delivering solid performance, but recommends financing with currencies other than the dollar, such as the euro. The euro has recently attracted traders looking to sidestep yen volatility.

Pierre‑Yves Bareau, head of emerging‑market bond at Morgan Asset Management, has reduced his carry‑trade exposure but still holds diversified positions in the Colombian peso, Brazilian real and Turkish lira, albeit at a smaller scale than at the start of the year.
He noted that volatility in markets such as Brazil, Egypt and Nigeria underscores the need for greater risk discipline: “You’ll still want to participate, but you have to be very disciplined.”

items.title: 股市賣壓與升息陰霾籠罩 澳元恐寫13年來最大單月跌幅
items.title_en: Stock Sell‑off and Rate‑Hike Cloud Loom Over Markets, Aussie Dollar Faces Its Biggest One‑Month Drop in 13 Years
paras: 受全球股市走弱及市場避險情緒升溫影響，澳元走勢持續受挫，面臨逾 13 年來最嚴重的單月跌幅。
澳元周三(25日)擴大跌幅，盤中跌幅一度達 1.1% 至 1.2%，匯率觸及 0.6559 美元，探至去年 12 月初以來的低點。統計顯示，澳元本月累計跌幅高達 6.6%，創下 2013 年 5 月以來最劇烈的單月下挫紀錄。
市場數據顯示，澳洲最新公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)通膨數據雖然高於經濟學家預期，曾激勵澳元早盤一度上揚 0.4%。然而，隨著亞洲股市走低，市場對與經濟成長掛鉤之貨幣的需求受抑，致使先前漲幅迅速被吐回。
不願具名的市場交易員指出，月底投資人調整投資組合部位，進一步加劇了澳元的下行壓力。
針對澳元後市發展，澳洲國民銀行(National Australia Bank Ltd.)資深外匯策略師Rodrigo Catril指出：「從技術指標來看，澳元目前已呈現超賣狀態；然而，在整體市場風險情緒獲得實質改善之前，澳元短期內恐將持續處於弱勢格局。」
此外，澳元在通膨數據發布後無法維持升勢，反映出市場開始意識到連續升息對澳洲經濟成長的衝擊正在浮現。德國商業銀行(Commerzbank)外匯策略師Michael Pfister對此評論稱：「與今年年初相比，澳洲央行未來若欲進一步升息，面臨的阻力與難度將顯著增加。」
Pfister進一步指出，在經濟成長放緩的背景下，即便是偏高的高通膨數據，也難以再為澳元提供強勁且持續的利多支撐。
paras_en: The Aussie dollar has continued to be battered, hit by weakening global equity markets and rising risk‑off sentiment, and is now facing its steepest one‑month decline in over 13 years.

On Wednesday (the 25th) the Aussie dollar widened its losses, sliding as much as 1.1%‑1.2% intraday to hit US$0.6559, a low not seen since early December last year. Statistics show the currency has fallen 6.6% this month, the sharpest monthly drop since May 2013.

Market data show that Australia’s latest consumer price index (CPI) inflation reading came in above economists’ forecasts and briefly lifted the Aussie dollar by about 0.4% in early trade. However, as Asian equities fell, demand for growth‑linked currencies waned, quickly erasing the earlier gains.
An unnamed market trader said investors were rebalancing portfolios at month‑end, adding further downward pressure on the Aussie dollar.

Regarding the Aussie dollar’s outlook, Rodrigo Catril, senior FX strategist at National Australia Bank Ltd., said: “Technically the Aussie dollar is now in oversold territory; however, until overall market risk sentiment improves materially, the currency is likely to remain weak in the short term.”

Moreover, the Aussie dollar failed to sustain its rise after the inflation data, reflecting growing market awareness that a string of rate hikes is beginning to weigh on Australia’s economic growth. Commerzbank FX strategist Michael Pfister commented: “Compared with the start of the year, any further rate‑hike moves by the Reserve Bank of Australia would face significantly greater resistance and difficulty.”
Pfister added that, against a backdrop of slowing growth, even relatively high inflation numbers are unlikely to provide the strong, sustained upside support for the Aussie dollar any longer.

Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO sparked a strong rebound in previously lagging tech stocks, lifting risk‑sensitive Aussie dollars modestly yesterday. Yet equity gains improving the economic outlook and pushing up U.S. short‑term Treasury yields have increased bets on further Fed tightening, strengthening the dollar. LSEG’s weekly data on U.S. market regulators show speculative short positions on the Aussie dollar at a record high, capping its rise and dragging the already fragile New Taiwan dollar to its lowest level since 2009, while the euro fell to a low of 1.0894 against the dollar.

According to an Ifo survey, Germany’s November business climate index was revised up to 90.6, above expectations, and firms reported greater satisfaction with current conditions; the expectations index rose to 91.9. ECB Governing Council member Silvana Tenreyro said the outlook remains uncertain but a December rate hike is likely, which could lift the euro to a high of 1.0979. The CBI’s November retail sales gap rose to +9, the strongest since December 2022, and retailers are optimistic about next month’s sales, echoing better‑than‑expected official data and pushing the pound up to a high of 1.3129. items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Falls as Nvidia-Driven AI Rally Cools
paras: 美元週二(24日)走低，回吐週一的大部分漲幅。此前黃仁勳重新出任輝達(NVDA-US)執行長，帶動AI類股大幅上漲，但這波漲勢隨後逐漸消退，交易員也開始質疑美元是否在短時間內漲得過快、過高。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.47%，報103.81
由於經濟成長依然強勁，通膨也持續頑強地高於聯準會(Fed)2%的目標，市場押注聯準會將繼續升息，為美元提供支撐。
不過，Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管 Elias Haddad 表示，「美國相較於歐元區、英國及日本的經濟成長優勢，在11月進一步縮小」，這可能對美元構成壓力。
根據芝商所（CME Group）FedWatch工具，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員目前預估，聯準會12月升息的機率為97%，明年1月再度升息的機率則為66%。
黃仁勳週一重新出任執行長，為股市帶來一些喘息空間，但部分分析師開始質疑，這波反彈究竟能持續多久。
近期股市震盪，也讓市場開始思考，聯準會究竟還能進一步緊縮貨幣政策到什麼程度，而不至於傷害經濟。AI投資熱潮吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長預期，進而帶動美元走強。當股市下跌時，美元通常也會發揮避險資產的作用。
美國週二公布的數據顯示，11月消費者信心增幅超出預期，升至近兩年來最高水準。受到本月期中選舉後，民眾對勞動市場狀況及整體經濟前景的樂觀情緒提振，消費者信心持續改善。
另一方面，德國企業信心連續第七個月於11月上升，也為歐元提供支撐。
歐元兌美元上漲0.6%，至1.0966美元。
日元兌美元下跌0.16%，至每美元159.24日元。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.64%，至1.3112美元。
澳幣兌美元上漲0.24%，至0.6641美元，但仍徘徊在11個月低點附近。過去一個月，澳幣是兌美元表現最差的主要貨幣，跌幅超過5%，主要因交易員持續押注澳洲央行可能降息。
摩根大通分析師表示，澳幣空頭部位已「大幅累積」，依照該行的衡量標準，部分情況下看空部位甚至已達到「極端水準」。
根據美國市場監管機構每週公布的數據，LSEG計算顯示，投機客目前持有的澳幣淨空頭部位創下歷史新高，規模約為122.5億美元。
摩根大通指出，「從選擇權市場來看，過去幾個月澳幣賣權的數量一直多於買權。在這波趨勢初期，我們原本合理認為，這可能只是宏觀經濟避險需求，而非真正押注澳幣走勢的方向性部位。不過，近期資金流向可能已逐漸轉向後者。」

paras_en: The dollar slipped on Tuesday (the 24th), giving back most of Monday's gains. Earlier, Jensen Huang resumed his role as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), spurring a sharp rise in AI stocks, but that rally has since faded and traders are beginning to question whether the dollar rose too quickly and too high in a short period.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.47% to 103.81.
Because economic growth remains strong and inflation stubbornly stays above the Fed's 2% target, the market is betting the Fed will keep raising rates, providing support for the dollar.

However, Elias Haddad, global markets strategist at Brown Brothers Harriman, said, "The United States' growth advantage over the euro area, the UK and Japan narrows further in November," which could put pressure on the dollar.
According to the CME Group FedWatch tool, futures traders currently see a 97% probability of a Fed rate hike in December and a 66% chance of another hike in January next year.
Jensen Huang's return as CEO on Monday gave the market a brief breather, but some analysts are now questioning how long this rebound can last.

Recent market volatility has prompted investors to wonder how far the Fed can tighten monetary policy without harming the economy. The AI investment boom has drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth expectations and strengthening the dollar. When equities fall, the dollar often acts as a safe‑haven asset.

U.S. data released on Tuesday showed November consumer confidence rose more than expected, reaching its highest level in nearly two years, buoyed by post‑midterm‑election optimism about the labor market and overall economic outlook.
Meanwhile, German business confidence rose for the seventh consecutive month in November, providing support for the euro.
The euro gained 0.6% against the dollar, to $1.0966.
The yen slipped 0.16% against the dollar, to ¥159.24 per dollar.
The pound rose 0.64% against the dollar, to $1.3112.

The Australian dollar rose 0.24% against the dollar, to $0.6641, but remains near an 11‑month low. Over the past month the Aussie was the worst‑performing major currency against the dollar, down more than 5%, mainly because traders continue to bet on a possible rate cut by the Reserve Bank of Australia.
JPMorgan analysts said Australian dollar short positions have "accumulated heavily" and, by the bank's standards, in some cases have reached "extreme" levels.
According to weekly data from U.S. regulators, LSEG calculations show speculative net short positions in the Australian dollar have hit a historic high of about $12.25 billion.

JPMorgan noted, "From the options market perspective, Australian dollar puts have outnumbered calls for several months. Early in the trend we thought this was mainly macro‑hedging demand rather than directional bets on the Aussie, but recent flows appear to be shifting toward the latter."
